Alɩf, Lɑɑm, Mɩɩm.
Ad Gaf-kãngã (Kʋrãɑnã) sik kɑ ɑ pʋgẽ ye, a yɑɑ kãndgr ne Wẽn-zoɛtbã.
Bãmb lɑ neb nins sẽn kõt sɩd ne sẽn solgã, lɑ b yɑlsd ne Pʋʋsgã, lɑ bũmb ning Tõnd sẽn lok-ba, b yãkdame n nɑfdẽ.
Bãmb lɑ neb nins yεsɑ sẽn kõt sɩd ne bũmb ning sẽn sik n kõ foo wã, lɑ sẽn sik tɩ reng taoorã, lɑ bãmb mɑɑnd bãng-n-wãɑk ne Yaoolem rãarã.
Bãmb rãmbã n be kãndgr zugu, la bãmb me lɑ põsdbã.
Ad neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã, zem tɑɑb bãmb zugu, fo bugs-b lɑme, fo pɑ bugs-bɑ, b pɑ kõt sɩd ye.
Wẽnd pɑgɑ b sũyã lɑ b wʋmbã, lɑ ludb n be b nenemẽ wã, lɑ nɑmsg sẽn yɑɑ bedre n be ne-bɑ.
Lɑ bee nebã pʋgẽ sẽn yete: "tõnd kõo sɩd ne Wẽnd lɑ Lɑɑhr dɑɑrã". La b yɑool n pɑ sɩd-kõtb ye.
B zãmbdɑ Wẽnde, ne neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdã, lɑ ad b pɑ zãmbd rẽndame tɩ yɑɑ b mens bɑlɑ, lɑ b pɑ ningd b yɑmẽ ye.
Bãɑg n be b sũyẽ wã tɩ Wẽnd pɑɑs-b bãɑgɑ, lɑ nɑng sẽn zɑbd n be ne-bɑ, b sẽn dɑ yɩ n yɑgdã yĩngɑ.
Lɑ b sã n yeel bãmba: "rɑ sãam-y tẽngã zug ye". Lɑ b sẽn yete: " ad tõnd yɑɑ mɑnegdbɑ".
Tɩ yɑool n yɑɑ bãmb la sãamdbã bɑlɑ, lɑ ɑd b pɑ ningd b yɑmẽ ne rẽ ye.
Lɑ b sã n yeel-ba: "kõ-y sɩd wɑlɑ nebã sẽn kõ sɩdã". Lɑ b sẽn yete: "tõnd nɑ kõ sɩd wɑlɑ yɑlemsã sẽn kõ sɩdã?" Sɩd-sɩdã, yɑɑ bãmb bɑl lɑ yɑlemsã, lɑ ɑd b pɑ mi ye.
Lɑ b sã n sεg sẽn kõ-b sɩdã lɑ b sẽn yete: "d kõo sɩdɑ". Lɑ b sã n leb b sʋtãan-taasã nengẽ, b yetɑme: " ad tõnd bee ne yãmbɑ, ad tõnd yɑɑnd-b lɑme".
Wẽnd nɑ yɑɑl-bɑ, lɑ A wogl-b b kedgrã zug tɩ b tuumdẽ.
Bãmbã la sẽn tek kãndgrã ne menengã, la b tolbã pɑ yã yõod ye, b pɑ yɩ me n yɑɑ kãndgdb ye.
Bãmb bilgr yɑɑ wɑlɑ ned ning bilgri sẽn widg bugum. Bugmã sẽn wa n vẽneg sẽn be yẽ kɩrengã lɑ Wẽnd sẽn loog ne bãmb vẽenmã n bɑs-b ligs pʋgẽ tɩ b pɑ neẽ ye.
Bãmb la wʋnse, mugsi, zoense, b pɑ mi b sẽn lebdẽ (b pɑ tõe n lebg ntʋg sɩd-kũunẽ wã ye).

Mɑɑ tɩ yɑɑ wɑ sɑ-koom sẽn kiigdi n yit saasẽ wã; ligs be beenẽ, sɑ-tãs be be, sɑ-yãgr be be, tɩ b ningd b nus-bi wã b tʋbẽ wã sɑ-tãsã yaeesg keelem, kũum zoees yĩnga. lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ Gũbgda ne kɩfr-dãmbã.

Sɑ-yãgrã rɑ pẽnegɑme n na n pɩsg b ninã nenmã, ɑ sã n yãge, la bãmb sẽn kẽnd a vẽenmã pʋgẽ; zĩigã sã n ligi, lɑ b sẽn yãnesde. lɑ Wẽnd sã n tʋllẽ, A nɑ loogẽ ne b wʋmbã lɑ b nenmã; ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ tõog Soɑb ne bũmbã fãa.
Yãmb ɑ nebɑ! tũ-y y Soɑbã, Soab ning sẽn nɑɑna yãmb lɑ sẽn deng-b yãmb tɑoorã, tɩ y nɑ pɑɑm wẽn-zoεεgɑ.

Saob ning sẽn mɑɑna tẽn-gãngã t'a yɑɑ sẽn yɑdgã, lɑ sɑɑsã tɩ yɑɑ mengo, lɑ A sik koom sẽn yit sɑɑsẽ wã, n yiisd ne ko-kãng sɑbɑbo, tɩ-biis tɩ yɑɑ rɩtl yãmb yĩnga. Bɩ y ra mɑɑn gees-n-tɑɑs ne Wẽnde, tɩ y yɑool n miẽ tɩ sẽn wõnd Yẽ kɑe ye.
Lɑ yãmb sã n be sik pʋgẽ ne bũmb ning Tõnd sẽn sik D Yambã zʋgã, bɩ y wɑ ne Sʋʋrɑ wɑlɑ ɑ buudu, lɑ y bool y sõngdbã zẽng sẽn pɑ Wẽnde, tɩ sã n mik tɩ yãmb yɑɑ sɩd rãmbɑ.
Lɑ yãmb sã n pɑ mɑɑne, y kõn n mɑɑn me lae! Bɩ y zoe bugumã, ɑ bõn-yõgends yɑɑ neb lɑ kuga, tɩ b sεglg-a-la kɩfr-dãmb yĩngɑ.

Lɑ f noog neb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩd lɑ b tʋm sõmsã sũyã, tɩ b tɑrɑ arzãn-dãmbɑ, tɩ ko-sood zoet b tẽngre. Wɑkt fãɑ b sã n rɩlg bãmb ɑ ti-biisã lɑ b sẽn yete: " yãoã bɑl lɑ b sẽn da dɩlg tõnd tɩ loogã". Tɩ b kõt-bɑ sẽn wõnd tɑɑba. B le tɑra pɑgb sẽn yɩlge, b le na n zĩnda be n duumdẽ.

Ad Wẽnd pɑ zoet yãnd (pɑsde) ne A rɩk bilgr ne sẽn zems rũn-vẽe-vẽe mɑɑ sẽn yɩɩd rẽ ye. Lɑ neb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩdã miime tɩ woto yɑɑ sɩd sẽn yi b Soɑbã nengẽ. Sã n yɑa sẽn kɩfl-bã yẽ, bãmb yetɑme: "yɑɑ bõe lɑ Wẽnd rat ne wãnde bilgr pʋgẽ! " A menemesdɑ me ne ɑ sɑbɑb neb wʋsgo lɑ A kãndg ne ɑ sɑbɑb neb wʋsgo, lɑ A pɑ menemesd ne-ɑ rẽnda dĩin-yitbã (kɩɩsdbã).
Neb nins sẽn yidgd Wẽnd alkɑoolã ɑ sẽn rɩ-kɑ poorẽ, lɑ b wãagd Wẽnd sẽn sɑgl tɩ b tõkã, lɑ b sãamd tẽngã zugã, bãmbã lɑ bõnɑ-rãmbã.
Yɩta wãn tɩ yãmb kɩfend ne Wẽnd tɩ yãmb yaool n da yɑɑ kiidbɑ t'A vʋʋg yãmbɑ, rẽ poorẽ t'A kʋ yãmba, rẽ poorẽ t'A vʋʋg yãmba, rẽ poorẽ A nengẽ lɑ y nɑ n lebe.
Yẽ lɑ Soɑb ning sẽn nɑɑn yãmb yĩngɑ, bũmb ning sẽn be tẽngã zug gilli, rẽ poorẽ t'A toglg sɑɑsẽ wã, n nɑɑn-b tɩ b yaa sɑɑs ɑ yopoe. A yɑɑ Mit ne bũmbã fãɑ.

Lɑ fo Soɑbã sẽn wɑ n yeel Mɑlεgsã: "ad Mɑm nɑ n ningɑ tẽngã zugu, lεdsdɑ". B yeelame : "F nɑ n ningɑ ɑ zugu, neb sẽn nɑ n sãɑmd ɑ zugu, lɑ b wɩdemd zɩɩm? Tɩ tõnd yaool n yɩlgda Fo yʋʋrã ne pẽgr lɑ d zɩsgd Fo?" A yeel-b lame : "ɑd Mɑm mii yãmb sẽn pɑ mi".
Lɑ A karma ɑ Adɑm bũmbã fãa yʋyã, rẽ poorẽ t'A wilg-b mɑlεgsã n yeele: " kõ-y Mɑɑm kibɑr ne bãmbã yʋyã tɩ yãmb sã n yɑɑ sɩd rãmbɑ.
Tɩ b yeele:" yɩlgr be ne Foom Wẽnde, bãngr pɑ be ne tõnd sã n pɑ Fo sẽn wĩnig tõnd ye, ɑd Foom lɑ a Mita( ne A sẽn gãnegd yell fãɑ ɑ zĩigẽ), foo la a Bʋʋdmita".
T'A yeele: "Adma! wĩnig bãmbã b yʋyã,". Lɑ ɑ sẽn wĩnig-b b yʋyã n sa, A yeelɑme: " M rɑ pɑ yeel yãmb tɩ Mɑm mii sɑɑsã lɑ tẽngã yel-soondɩ, lɑ M le mi yãmb sẽn vẽnegdã lɑ yãmb sẽn dɑ solgdã?
La wakat ning Tõnd sẽn wɑ n yeel Mɑlεgsã : "mɑɑn-y ɑ Adɑm Suguudu". B fãa tiuulame, sã n pɑ ɑ Ibliis n tõdge, n mɑɑn wɑoog-m-mengɑ n yɩ kɩfre.
Tõnd le yeelame : " Yaa fo a Adma, zĩndi, foom ne f pɑgã Arzãnã pʋgẽ, lɑ y rɩ ɑ pʋgẽ ne mɑɑn-m-yɑm yãmb sẽn dɑt fãɑ, lɑ y rɑ pẽneg tɩ-kãngã tɩ y yɩtɑ wẽg-m-mens rãmbɑ.

T'ɑ sʋtãan kɩt tɩ b yiibã sɑlg tɩɩgẽ wã, tɩ b yiis b yiibã fãa b sẽn dɑ beẽ wã, tɩ Tõnd yeel-bɑ: sig-y tẽngã tɩ yãmb ne tɑɑb yɑɑ beem. Lɑ yãmb tɑrɑ tẽngã zugu, tɑbleg zĩigɑ, lɑ yãmb sẽn na n tall n vɩɩm n tʋg wɑkɑte.
T'ɑ Adɑm reeg goam sẽn yi ɑ Soɑbã nengẽ, t'A reeg ɑ tuubgã. Ad Soabã yɑɑ Tuubgrεεgdɑ, n yɑa Yolsdɑ.
Tɩ Tõnd yeele: "sig-y y fãa gilli. La kãndgr sã n wɑ yãmb nengẽ sẽn yit Mɑm nengẽ, bãng-y tɩ sẽn tũ-b Mɑm Kãndgrã, yaεεs kɑ ne-ba, b kõn n sãɑm b sũur me".
Lɑ sẽn kɩfl-b lɑ b yɑgs Tõnd aɑyɑ-rãmba, bãmbã lɑ Bugum koɑmbɑ, n duumd be.
Yaa yãmb ɑ ɭsrɑɩɩl koɑmba! Tẽeg-y Mɑm Neemã ning M sẽn mɑɑn yãmb zugã lɑ y pids Mɑm alkɑoolã tɩ M nɑ pids y alkɑoole. lɑ yɑees-y Maam M yembr bɑlɑ.
Lɑ kõ-y sɩd ne Mɑm sẽn sik tɩ sɩdgd sẽn be ne yãmbã. La rɑ yɩ-y neb nins sẽn na n deng n kɩfl ne-ɑ ye. La rɑ koos-y Mɑm Aɑyɑ-rãmbã ne ligd bilf ye. Lɑ Maam bal la y sɛgd n zoe.
Lɑ ra gẽdg-y sɩd ne zɑɑlem (ziri) ye. Ra solg-y sɩd me tɩ y sã n mi-a ye.
Yãnes-y pʋʋsg me lɑ y kõ zɑka, lɑ y zõond (pʋʋse) n lɑgem zõondba.
Yãmb na n sɑgendɑ nebã ne mɑnegr lɑ y yĩmd y mense, tɩ yãmb yɑool n kɑremdɑ Gɑfã, yãmb pɑ tɑgsd la?
Lɑ kos-y sõngre, sugr maaneg lɑ pʋʋsg pʋgẽ, lɑ ɑd rẽ yɑɑ toogo, sã n pɑ ne wẽn-zoɛtbã.
B rãmb nins sẽn tẽed tɩ bãmb nɑ n yekɑ b Soɑbã lɑ bãmb yɑɑ lεbdbɑ A nengẽ.
Yaa ɭsrɑyɩɩl koɑmbɑ ! Tẽeg-y Mɑm neema wã M sẽn mɑɑn yãmb zugã, lɑ Mɑm yɩɩs yãmb bõn-nɑɑndsã zugu.
Lɑ y zoe rɑɑr ningɑ yõor sẽn pɑ sekd ɑ yõ-tɑɑg bɑɑ fʋɩ, lɑ b pɑ sɑkd ɑ nengẽ sugsgu ( se-yõkre) , la b pɑ reegd ɑ nengẽ yɑoobo. La bãmb pɑ yɩ b sẽn nɑ n sõng-b rãmbɑ.

Lɑ y tẽeg wɑkɑt ning Tõnd sẽn tɩlg yãmb n yi ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoon zɑkã rãmbɑ, b rɑ sɩbgdɑ yãmbɑ sɩbg-wẽngɑ, n koot yãmb kom-ribli wã lɑ b bɑsd yãmb kom-pugli wã, lɑ woto yɑɑ zɑrb-n-gesg sẽn yaa bedr n yi yãmb Soɑbã nengẽ.
Lɑ tẽeg-y Tõnd sẽn wɑ n pãrg mogrã y yĩngɑ, n tɩlg yãmb lɑ D bõr ɑ Fɩr-ʿaoon zɑkã rãmb tɩ yãmb getẽ.
La y tẽeg wɑkɑt ning Tõnd sẽn pʋlem ɑ Musɑ yʋnd pis-nɑɑse, rẽ poorẽ tɩ yãmb rɩk lullã n tũud ɑ kudgẽ, tɩ yãmb yɑɑ wẽg-m-mens rãmbɑ.
Rẽ poorẽ tɩ Tõnd yɑɑf yãmba, bõe yĩngɑ tɩ y nɑ pʋʋs bɑrkɑ.
Lɑ Tõnd sẽn wɑ n kõ ɑ Musɑ Gɑfã lɑ Wεlgrã, bõe yĩng tɩ y nɑ kãndge.

La tẽeg wɑkɑt ning ɑ Musɑ sẽn yeel ɑ nebã: "Yɑɑ mam neba! Ad yãmb wẽgɑ y mense, ne yãmb sẽn tũ lullã, bɩ y tuub n tʋg y Yẽbgdã nengẽ n kʋ y mensã, rẽndɑ lɑ sõmã ne yãmb y yẽbgdã nengẽ t'A reeg yãmb tuubgã, ɑd Yẽ lɑ a Tuubgrεεgda n yɑa Yoɑlsdɑ".
Lɑ yãmb sẽn wɑ n yeele : "Musɑ, tõnd kõn n kõ sɩd ne-f lɑe-lae sã n pɑ d yãa Wẽnd vẽenegɑ". Tɩ bugum nɑ n dɩk yãmb tɩ y getẽ.
Rẽ poorẽ tɩ Tõnd yɑɑf yãmba, bõe yĩng tɩ y nɑ pʋʋs bɑrkɑ.
Lɑ D luda yãmb zug ne sɑwɑto; lɑ D sik belem lɑ Tãntãn-noog,: "rɩ-y yɩlgemd buud fãa Tõnd sẽn rɩlg yãmba". Lɑ ad bãmb pɑ wẽng Tõnd ye, lɑ yɑɑ b mens bɑl lɑ b yɩ n wẽngd wakat fãa.

Lɑ tẽeg-y wɑkɑt ning Tõnd sẽn yeele: " kẽ-y tẽng-kãngã n dɩ ɑ pʋgẽ yãmb sẽn rɑtẽ ne mɑɑn-m-rɑɑbo, lɑ y kẽ rɑg-noorã tɩ y yɑɑ kuudbɑ, lɑ y yeele: " lub d zũnuubã", tɩ D nɑ yɑɑf yãmb tʋʋm-tuutsã, lɑ D nɑ n pɑɑsɑ mɑnegdbã.
Tɩ sẽn wẽngbã tedg gomdã zẽng sẽn pɑ b sẽn yeel bãmbã, tɩ Tõnd sik sẽn wẽngbã zugu, nɑng sẽn yi sɑɑsẽ b sẽn dɑ yit Dĩinã sɑbɑb yĩngɑ.

Lɑ ɑ Musɑ sẽn wɑ n kos yũnugrã, Tõnd yeelame: "wẽ kugrã ne f rɑsaarã". T'ɑ pus ko-nin piig lɑ ɑ yiibu. Sɩdɑ, ned fãa bãnga ɑ yũub zĩigɑ. Rɩ-y lɑ y yũ Wẽnd rɩtlã, lɑ y rɑ kẽn tẽngã zug n yɑɑ sãɑmdb ye.

Lɑ yãmb sẽn wɑ n yeele: "Musɑ! Tõnd kõn n mɑɑn sugr ne rɩɩb ɑ yembr ye, bɩ f kos f Soɑbã d yĩngɑ t'A yiis n kõ-do, tẽngã sẽn bundã, sẽn yɑɑ zẽ-biis lɑ ɑ mɑrmɑande (Kõnkõmbr), lɑ ɑ lɑy, lɑ ɑ Adɑs (Lentilles), lɑ gɛbɑ. T'ɑ yeel-bɑ: "yalla (rẽ yĩngɑ) yãmb na n tedgdɑ sẽn yɑa sõma ne bũmb sẽn pɑoode? Sig-y tẽngã pʋgẽ tɩ yãmb sẽn kosã y nɑ pɑɑm be. Tɩ b lims-b ne yɑɑlg lɑ nimbãanegɑ, n wa bɑɑs ne gẽeg sẽn yi Wẽnd nengẽ, bɑla bãmb rɑ yɩɩme n kɩfl ne Wẽnd aayɑ-rãmbã(tɑgmas-rãmbã) lɑ b kʋʋd Nɑbiyɑɑm-rãmbã tɩ pɑ tũ ne sɩd ye, tɩ rẽ yɑɑ b sẽn kɩɩsã lɑ b rɑ yɩ n mɑɑnd n zʋʋgdẽ wã yĩnga.

Ad sẽn kõ-b sɩdã, lɑ Yɑhʋʋd-rãmbã lɑ Nɑsɑɑr-rãmbã; lɑ Dĩin pʋgdbã, ned woo ned fãa sẽn kõ sɩd ne Wẽnd lɑ Lɑɑhr dɑɑrã lɑ a tʋm sẽn yɑɑ sõmã, rẽnd b tɑrɑ keoor b Soɑbã nengẽ, lɑ yεεsg kɑ ne bãmb ye, bãmb me kõn n sãɑm b sũy ye.
Lɑ y tẽeg Tõnd sẽn dɑ reeg yãmb Alkɑool lɑ D zẽk tãngã yãmb zugu n bugsd yãmbɑ, n yeel yã: "reeg-y Tõnd sẽn kõ yãmbã ne pãngɑ lɑ y tẽeg sẽn be ɑ pʋgẽ wã, bõe yĩng tɩ y nɑ pɑɑm wẽn-zoεεgɑ".
Tɩ yãmb gũd y kudg rẽ poorẽ, lɑ sã n pɑ Wẽnd Yɩɩdlemã sẽn be yãmb zugã lɑ A Yolsgã, yãmb rag n nɑ yɩ bõn-rãmbɑ.
Lɑ yãmb bãngɑ pɑe sẽn mɑɑn-b tɩ zʋʋg sibrã rɑɑrã tɩ Tõnd yeel-bɑ: "yɩ-y wãɑms ne faagre".
Tɩ Tõnd mɑɑn-ɑ t'ɑ yɑɑ tags-n-gεsg ne tẽms nins sẽn kεg-bɑ la sẽn nɑ wɑtbã, lɑ wɑɑzu ne wẽn-zoɛtbã.
La tẽeg-y ɑ Musɑ sẽn wɑ n yeel ɑ nebã: "ɑd Wẽnd sɑgendɑ yãmb tɩ y kodg nɑɑfo". Lɑ b yeel yã: "fo yɑɑndɑ tõnd la?" T'ɑ yeele: "m kot gũudum ne Wẽnde, n dɑ yɩ zɩtbã pʋgẽ yembr ye".
Lɑ b yeel yã: " kos f Soɑbã d yĩng t'A vẽneg ɑ sẽn yɑa to-to". T'ɑ yeele: "ɑd A yeelɑme tɩ yɑɑ nɑɑfo, ɑ pɑ kʋdre, ɑ bilɑ, ɑ yɑɑ tẽng-n-sʋgre, bɩ y mɑɑn b sẽn sɑgl-y wã".
Lɑ b yeel yã: "kos f soɑbã t'A vẽneg ɑ kõbgã n kõ tõndo". T'a yeele: "ɑd A yetɑme t'ɑ yɑɑ nɑg-rõod sẽn yɑa hão, n noom gεtbɑ".
Lɑ b yeel yã: "kos f Soɑbã t'A vẽneg ɑ sẽn yɑa to-to ɑd niisã gẽdgame lɑ ɑd tõndo - Wẽnd sã n sɑke - d nɑ kãndge.

T'a yeele: " t'A yetɑme t'a yɑɑ nɑɑfo, ɑ pɑ nɑg-nomdg sẽn koode, ɑ leb n pɑ yũnugd koodo, yaa naaf sẽn tɩlg n yi zɑng fãa, tẽgs-tẽgs kɑ be ɑ yĩngã zug ye". Lɑ b yeel yã: "moasã lɑ f wa ne sɩdã". Tɩ b kodg-ɑ lɑ b rɑ pɑ nɑ n mɑɑnẽ ye.
Lɑ y tẽeg yãmb sẽn dɑ kʋ yõore, tɩ yãmb maan tɑk-n-tɑɑr a yellã zugu, lɑ ad Wẽnd nɑ n pukɑ yãmb sẽn da yɩ n solgdẽ wã.
Tɩ Tõnd yeele: "yãk-y naafã pedg n wẽ-a", yɑɑ woto bɑl lɑ Wẽnd vʋʋgd kũ-rãmbɑ, lɑ A wĩnigd yãmb A aɑya wã, bõe yĩng tɩ y nɑ tɑll yɑm.

Tɩ yãmb sũyã kʋɩɩ rẽ poorẽ n lebg wɑ kugɑ bɩ b keelem yɩɩd rẽ, bɑla be kugẽ wã ko-sood sẽn pusd n yit ɑ pʋgẽ, lɑ be ɑ pʋgẽ sẽn weet tɩ koom yit ɑ pʋgẽ, lɑ be ɑ pʋgẽ sẽn yit yĩngr n lʋɩtẽ, wẽn-zoεεsg keelem yĩnga, lɑ ad Wẽnd pɑ yɑm yɑɑl-yɑɑl soɑb ( bɑsdɑ) ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã ye
Yalla yãmb tẽedɑme tɩ b nɑ kõ sɩd ne yãmb tɩ sɩd lɑ hɑkɩɩkɑ zãma n dɑ be b pʋgẽ wã n kelgd Wẽnd goɑmã, rẽ poorẽ tɩ b teem-a b sẽn fɑhem ɑ võorã kudgẽ tɩ bãmb yɑool n miẽ!

Lɑ b sã n sεg sɩd-kõtbã lɑ b sẽn yete: "tõnd kõo sɩdɑ". Lɑ b sã n tɩ lɑk ne tɑɑb lɑ b sẽn yete: "yãmb yẽsd-b lɑme ne bũmb ning Wẽnd sẽn pɑk n kõ-yã tɩ b nɑ n pɑɑm n gom n lʋb yãmb y Soɑbã nengẽ, yãmb pɑ tɑr yɑm lɑ?"
Yalla bãmb pɑ mi tɩ Wẽnd n mi bãmb sẽn solgdã lɑ b sẽn vẽnegdã la?
Lɑ be b pʋgẽ sẽn yɑa zoob-sɑblɑ, sẽn pɑ mi Gɑfã rẽndɑ tẽ-yɑɑlse, lɑ bãmb pɑ yɩ rẽnda sãmbdba.
Rẽnd wɩɩbd be ne sẽn gʋlsd-b Gɑfã ne b nus n yɑool n yetẽ: " yãoã yii Wẽnd nengẽ". Sẽn nɑ pɑɑm n koos-ɑ ne ligd bilfu, ɑd wɩɩbd be ne-bɑ, b nusã sẽn gʋlsã, lɑ wɩɩbd be ne-bɑ b sẽn pɑɑmd ɑ pʋgẽ wã
Lɑ b leb n yeelame: "Bugum kõn n tol n sɩɩs tõndo, rẽndɑ rɑsem-rãmb sɑɑre". Yeel-bɑ: " Yalla yãmb rɩkɑ Alkɑool Wẽnd nengẽ, rẽnd Wẽnd pɑ viigd ɑ Alkɑool la, bɩ yãmb yetɑ Wẽnd zug y sẽn pɑ mi?"
Yɑɑ sɩdɑ, sẽn tʋma zũnuub t'ɑ tʋʋm-tuuti wã gũbg-ɑ, bãmb lɑ Bugum koɑmbɑ, tɩ b yɑɑ duumdb ɑ pʋgẽ.
Lɑ sẽn kõ-b sɩdã lɑ b tʋm sõmã wã, bãmb lɑ Arzãn koɑmbɑ tɩ bãmb yɑɑ duumdb ɑ pʋgẽ.

Tẽeg Tõnd sẽn rɑ reeg ɭsrɑɑɩl koɑmb Alkɑoole : "tɩ y rɑ tũ tɩ sã n pɑ Wẽnde, lɑ y mɑneg y roɑgb a yiibã, lɑ rog-pẽtse, lɑ kɩɩbse, lɑ nimbãɑn-nebã, lɑ y yeel nebã sẽn be neere, lɑ y yãnes Pʋʋsgo lɑ y kõ Zɑka, rẽ poorẽ tɩ yãmb rɑeege sã n pɑ y bilf bɑlɑ, tɩ yãmb yɑɑ bɑlldbɑ.
Lɑ Tõnd sẽn dɑ reeg yãmb Alkɑoole: " rɑ wɩdem-y zɩɩm ye, lɑ y rɑ yiis tɑɑbɑ y zɑgsẽ ye,". Tɩ yãmb reeg y zugẽ n mɑɑn kɑseto.

Tɩ yãmb lebge, yãmb bɑlɑ, n kʋʋd taaba, lɑ y yiisd sul yãmb pʋgẽ b zɑgsẽ la y sõngdẽ tɩ b kʋʋd-bɑ. B sã n yõg-b tɩ b wɑ yãmb nengẽ lɑ yãmb sẽn yɑood n reegd-bɑ tɩ b yiisgã meng rɑg n yɑɑ Hɑrɑɑm ne yãmbɑ. Yãmb nɑ n kõtɑ sɩd ne Gɑfã gom-sãndɑ lɑ y kɩfend ne sãndɑ? Lɑ sẽn mɑɑnd-ɑ rẽ yãmb pʋgẽ rolb nɑ n yɩɩ wãn-wãn tɩ sã n pɑ yãnd ningr Dũni vɩɩmẽ, tɩ Alkɩyɑoom rɑɑre, bɩ b lεbs-b nɑng kεgengã pʋgẽ, lɑ Wẽnd pɑ nɑ n bɑs yãmb sẽn tʋmdã n pɑ yɑo-y ye.
Bãmb lɑ sẽn rɑ Dũni vɩɩmã ne Lɑɑhrã, b pɑ nɑ n boog ( fɑɑg) nɑngã bãmb zugu, b kõn n sõng-bɑ.

Lɑ sɩd lɑ hɑkɩɩkɑ, Tõnd kõo ɑ Musɑ Gɑfã lɑ D pʋglg yẽ poorẽ Tẽn-tʋʋmbɑ, lɑ D kõ ɑ ʿIisa sẽn yɑɑ ɑ Mɑryɑm biigã vẽenese lɑ D rɑool-ɑ ne Yõ-yɩlengã. Tẽn-tʋʋm sẽn wɑ yãmb nengẽ fãa ne sẽn pɑ tɑ yãmb yɑm, y wɑoogdɑ y mensã. Be sãnda y sẽn yɑgse, sãnda me y kʋʋdɑ me.
Lɑ b yeel yã: "tõnd sũyã ludɑme, ɑyae! Yɑɑ Wẽnd n kãab-b b kɩflgã yĩngɑ, tɩ pɑood b pʋgẽ sẽn kɩt sɩdɑ.

Lɑ Alkʋrãɑn sẽn wɑ n wɑ bãmb nengẽ tɩ yɑɑ Gɑf sẽn yi Wẽnd nengẽ n sɩdgd sẽn be ne bãmbã -b yaool n dɑ yɩɩme n dɑ gũud sõngr ne-ɑ kɩfr-rãmbã zugu- lɑ sẽn wɑ n wɑ b nengẽ bũmb ning bãmb sẽn yã n bãnge, b kɩflɑ ne-ɑ. Rẽnd Wẽnd kãab-beed be ne kɩfr-dãmbã.

Bũmb ning bãmb sẽn tek ne b mensã yɩ wẽngɑ, ne bãmb sẽn kɩfl ne bũmb ning Wẽnd sẽn sikã, mɑɑn-n-zʋʋg (sũ-kĩiri) bɑla, tɩ Wẽnd n sik A yɩɩdlemã n kõ A sẽn tʋll a soɑbɑ, tɩ bãmb bɑɑs ne gẽeg zugu, lɑ kɩfr-rãmbã tɑrɑ nɑn-fɑɑgdgɑ.

Lɑ b sã n yeel bãmbɑ: "kõ-y sɩd ne Wẽnd sẽn sikã b yetɑme tõnd kõtɑ sɩd ne sẽn sik n kõ tõndã" lɑ b kɩfend ne sẽn pɑ rẽ wã, tɩ rẽ n yɑool n yɑɑ sɩd n sɩdgd sẽn be ne bãmbã. Yeel-bɑ: " lɑ yɑɑ bõe tɩ y kʋʋd Wẽnd Nɑbiyɑɑm-rãmbã sẽn dɑ loogã tɩ y sã n yɑa sɩd-kõtbɑ?"
Lɑ ɑ Musɑ wɑa yãmb nengẽ ne vẽenese, rẽ poorẽ tɩ yãmb tũ lullã ɑ kudgẽ tɩ yãmb yɑɑ wẽgdbɑ.

Lɑ Tõnd sẽn dɑ reeg yãmb Alkɑoolã lɑ D lulg tãngã yãmb zug lɑ D yeel yã : "reeg-y Tõnd sẽn kõ yãmbã ne pãng lɑ y kelge". Lɑ b yeel yã: "Tõnd wʋmɑme lɑ d kɩɩsɑme". Tɩ b yũnug bãmb sũyã ne lullã tũudum nonglem. Yeel-ba: yãmb Lɩɩmɑoongã sẽn sɑgend yãmb ne bũmb ningã yɩ wẽngɑ, tɩ yãmb sã n yɑɑ sɩd-kõtbɑ.
Yeele: "sã n mikɑme tɩ Lɑɑhr Zɑkã yɑɑ toor zɑll ne yãmb n pɑ lɑgemd nebã, bɩ y tʋll kũumã tɩ y sã n yɑɑ sɩd rãmbɑ.
Lɑ b kõn n tol n tʋll-ɑ lɑe, b nusã sẽn tʋm tɩ reng tɑoorã yĩngɑ, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ mitɑ ne wẽgdbã.

Lɑ fo nɑ mik-bɑ, tɩ bãmb n yɩɩd nebã ne vɩɩm nonglem n yɩɩd kɩfr-rãmbã mengɑ. B yembr fãa nongɑme n nɑ n vɩɩmes yʋʋm tusri, lɑ rẽ pɑ nɑ n zãɑg-ɑ n yi nɑngã t'ɑ kʋʋlɑme yĩng ye, la ad Wẽnd yaa net ne b sẽn tʋmdã.
Yeele: "sẽn yɑɑ Gibriil bε bɩ ɑ bãng tɩ yaa yẽnd n sik-ɑ fo sũurã pʋgẽ ne Wẽnd tõogo n sɩdgd sẽn be ɑ tɑoorã lɑ yɑɑ kãndgre lɑ sũ-noogr ne sɩd-kõtbã".
Sẽn tɑrɑ beem ne Wẽnd lɑ A Mɑlεgsã lɑ A tẽn-tʋʋmã lɑ a Gibriil lɑ ɑ Mɩɩkɑyɩɩlɑ, rẽnd Wẽnd yɑɑ bε ne kɩfr-rãmbã.
Lɑ sɩd-sɩdɑ, D sikɑme tɩ wɑ f nengẽ aɑyɑ-rãmb sẽn yaɑ vẽenese; lɑ pɑ kɩfend ne-ɑ rẽndɑ Dĩin yitbã.
Bãmb sẽn dɩk Alkɑool fãa, bãmb pʋgẽ sull n lobgd-ɑ, ɑd b wʋsg fãa pɑ kõt sɩd ye.
Lɑ Tẽn-tʋʋm sẽn wɑ n wɑ bãmb nengẽ, sẽn yi Wẽnd nengẽ n sɩdgd sẽn be ne bãmbã, lɑ sul sẽn be b sẽn kõ-b rãmb Gɑfã pʋgẽ lobg Wẽnd Gɑfã b poay tɩ yɑɑ wɑ bãmb pɑ mi ye.

Lɑ b pʋg sʋɩɩtãambã sẽn kɑremd ɑ Sʋlɑymɑɑn Nɑɑmẽ wã, lɑ ɑ Sʋlɑymɑɑn pɑ kɩfl ye, lɑ ɑd yɑɑ sʋɩɩtãambã n kɩfle. B winigdɑ nebã tɩɩm lɑ sẽn sik mɑlεk ɑ yɩɩbã zugã Bɑɑbɩɩl tẽngẽ sẽn yɑa ɑ Hɑɑrʋʋt lɑ ɑ Mɑɑrʋʋt. Lɑ b yiibã pɑ wĩnigd ned rẽnd tɩ b yeel-ɑ: "ɑd tõnd yɑɑ zɑrb-n-gesgɑ, bɩ f rɑ kɩfl ye". Tɩ b kɑremdẽ b yiibã nengẽ bũmb sẽn nɑ welg ned ne ɑ pɑg sʋkɑ. Lɑ bãmb pɑ yɩ n nɑms ne-ɑ ned bɑɑ a yembr rẽndɑ ne Wẽnd tõogo. Lɑ b kɑremdɑ sẽn nɑmsd-bɑ, n pɑ nɑfd-bɑ, lɑ b bãngɑme tɩ sẽn tekɑ ne-ɑ, ɑ pɑ tɑr Lɑɑhrã, pʋɩɩr buud ye, lɑ bũmb ning bãmb sẽn tedg ne b mensã yɩ wẽngɑ, tɩ b sã n da miimẽ.
Lɑ bãmb sã n dɑ kõẽ sɩd lɑ b zoe Wẽnde, ɑd yel-sõmd sẽn yi Wẽnd nengẽ n yɩɩd sõmblem, tɩ b sã n da miẽ lame.

Yɑɑ yãmb neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdɑ! rɑ yeel-y {Rɑɑɩnɑɑ} gũ tõnd ye (bɑlaa tʋʋsr n be gom-bɩ-kãngã pʋgẽ, tɩ Yɑhʋʋd rãmbã tũnugd n tʋʋd nɑbiyɑɑmã). Lɑ yeel-y {õnzʋrnɑɑ} yãnes n gũ-du, lɑ y kelge, lɑ kɩfr-rãmbã tɑrɑ nɑng sẽn zɑbde.

Ad sẽn kɩfl-bã sẽn yɑa Gɑfã rãmbã lɑ kɩfr-rãmbã, b pɑ nongẽ n rɑt tɩ sig yãmb zug sẽn yɑɑ sõmɑ buud fãa n yit yãmb Soɑbã nengẽ ye. Lɑ Wẽnd welgda A Yolsgã n kõ A sẽn tʋll ɑ soabɑ, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ kõ-bedr Soɑbɑ.
Tõnd pɑ yikd aɑyɑr fãɑ mɑa tɩ D yĩms-ɑ rẽnd tɩ D wɑ ne sẽn são-ɑ mɑɑ ɑ bilgri, fo pɑ bãng tɩ Wẽnd yɑɑ tõog Soɑb ( Kordg Nɑɑbɑ) ne bũmb fãɑ la?
Fo pɑ bãng tɩ Wẽnd n so Sɑɑs lɑ Tẽng Nɑɑm, lɑ yãmb pɑ tɑr zẽng sẽn pɑ Wẽnde; lɑlld bɩ sõngd ye!
Bɩ yãmb rɑt n soka y Tẽn-tʋʋmã wɑ b sẽn rɑ sok ɑ Musɑ, lɑ sẽn tedgdɑ sɩd-kũun ne kɩfendo, ɑ soɑb tudgɑ so-tɩrgã.

Wʋsg sẽn be Gɑfã rãmbẽ nongɑme tɩ yãmb lebg kɩfend-dãmba, y sɩd-kũunã poorẽ, sũ-kĩir sẽn yi bãmb nengẽ bala; sɩdã sẽn vẽneg bãmb nengẽ poorẽ. Bɩ y yɑɑf lɑ y bɑs tɩ looge, hɑl tɩ Wẽnd yellã wɑ tɑ; ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ tõod (kord Nɑɑb) ne bũmb fãɑ.
Lɑ y yãnes Pʋʋsg lɑ y kõ Zɑk, lɑ yãmb sẽn tʋm tɩ yɑɑ sõmɑ fãɑ y mikd-ɑ-lɑ Wẽnd nengẽ, ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ netɑ ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.
Lɑ b yeele: "kõn n tol n kẽ arzãnɑ, sã n pɑ sẽn yɑɑ Yɑhʋʋdɑ mɑɑ Nɑsɑɑrɑ". Rẽ yɑɑ bãmb sɑɑg-zɑɑlɑ, yeele: "wɑ-y ne y tikri, tɩ y sã n yɑɑ sɩd rãmbɑ".
Yɑɑ sɩdɑ! Ad sẽn mɑɑnɑ pʋ-peelem (yɩlg ɑ dĩinɑ) ne Wẽnde, tɩ yẽ yɑɑ Mɑnegdɑ, ɑ tarɑ a keoor Wẽnd nengẽ, yεεsg kɑ ne bãmbɑ, b kõn n sãɑm b sũyã.

Lɑ Yɑhʋʋd-rãmb yeelɑme: "Nɑsɑɑr-rãmbã pɑ be fʋɩ zugu". Tɩ Nɑsɑɑr-rãmb yeele: "Yɑhʋʋd-rãmbã pɑ be fʋɩ zug ye". Tɩ bãmb yɑool n kɑremd Gɑfã. Yɑɑ woto bɑl lɑ sẽn pɑ mi-bã (zɩtbã) yeel yã, wɑlɑ bãmb gomdã buudu. Rẽnd Wẽnd n bʋʋd bãmb ne tɑɑb sʋka, bãmb sẽn dɑ yɩ n yõsd tɑɑb ɑ poorẽ wã.

Lɑ ãnd wẽgd n yɩɩd sẽn gɩdgɑ Wẽnd Misã wã tɩ b rɑ tẽeg A yʋʋrã b pʋsẽ, lɑ b kẽnd n bɑood b nɑ wur-bɑ, bãmbɑ rɑ pɑ sõmb ne bãmb tɩ b kẽ misɑ wã pʋsẽ rẽndɑme tɩ b yɑɑ yεεsdbɑ. B tɑrɑ yãnd dũni kɑ, tɩ Lɑɑhrã b tɑrɑ nɑmsg sẽn yɑɑ zɩsgo
lɑ Wẽnd n so yɑɑng lɑ wĩnto-lʋɩɩngẽ, rẽnd yãmb sẽn toglẽ fãɑ, be lɑ Wẽnd be, ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ Kõt Yɑleng Soɑbɑ n yɑɑ Mitɑ
Lɑ b yeele: "Wẽnd tɑrɑ biigɑ" Ad A Nɑɑm yɩlg yã! Pɑ woto ye, A soo sẽn be Sɑɑsẽ lɑ sẽn be Tẽngẽ, ãnkãm fãɑ yɑɑ sẽn zelg ne A tũudmã.
Yɑɑ Sɑɑs lɑ Tẽng yẽbgdɑ, A sã n bʋ yelle, A yet-ɑ lɑme: "yɩ". T'ɑ be yɩɩbo.

Lɑ sẽn pɑ mi-bã yeelɑme:"yɑɑ bõe tɩ Wẽnd pɑ nɑ n gom ne tõndo, mɑɑ tɩ yel-soalem wɑ tõnd nengẽ?" Yɑɑ woto bɑl lɑ sẽn reng-b bãmb taoorã yeel yã, wɑlɑ bãmb koεεgã, bãmb sũyã wõnegɑ tɑɑbɑ, tõnd vẽnegɑ aɑyɑ wã ne bãng-n-wãakã rãmbɑ.
Ad Tõnd tʋmsɑ foom ne sɩdɑ tɩ f yɑɑ sũ-noogdɑ lɑ bugsdɑ, lɑ b pɑ nɑ n sok foom bugum koɑmbã yell ye.

Lɑ Yɑhʋʋd-rãmbã kõn n yɑr foo lae, Nɑsɑɑr-rãmb me kõn n yar foo lae, hɑl tɩ fo wɑ pʋg b Dĩinã. Yeele: "ad Wẽnd Kãndgrã, yẽ lɑ Kãndgre, lɑ lɑk fo sã n pʋg bãmbã yɑmleoodã, bãngrã sẽn wɑ fo nengẽ wã poore, fo pa tɑr sẽn nɑ n fãɑg foo Wẽnd nengẽ sẽn yɑɑ lɑllda, f pɑ tar sõngdɑ.
Tõnd sẽn kõ-b rãmb Gɑfã, b kɑremd-ɑ lɑme kɑreng tεkẽ, lɑ sẽn kɩfl-b ne-ɑ wã, bãmbã lɑ bõn rãmbɑ.
ɭsrɑyɩɩl koɑmbɑ! Tẽeg-y Mɑm neema wã M sẽn mɑɑn yãmb zugã, lɑ Mɑm sẽn yɩɩs yãmb bõn-nɑɑndsã zugã.
Lɑ y zoe rɑɑr ning yõor sẽn pɑ sekd ɑ yõ-tɑɑg fʋɩ, lɑ b pɑ sɑkd yaood ɑ nengẽ, tɩ sugsg (sε-yõkr) pɑ nɑfd-ɑ, bãmb pɑ yɩ b sẽn nɑ n sõngd-b rãmb me.

Lɑ ɑ ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm Soɑbã sẽn wɑ n zɑr-bɑ n nɑ n ges ne Gom-biisi, t'ɑ pids-bɑ, tɩ Wẽnd yeele: " Mɑm ningɑ fo tɩ f yɑɑ nebã tɑoor soɑbɑ". t'ɑ yeele: "lɑ mɑm koɑmbẽ wã?" T'A yeele: "Mɑm Alkɑoolã pɑ tɑt Wẽgdbã ye".

Lɑ tẽeg Tõnd sẽn mɑɑn Roogã tɩ yɑɑ Lεbeng zĩigɑ ne nebã lɑ bɑs-m-yɑm: " lɑ y rɩk-y ɑ ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm nɑ-tɑgdrẽ wã tɩ yɩ Pʋʋsg zĩigɑ". Lɑ Tõnd sɑglɑ ɑ ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm ne ɑ ɭsmɑɑyɩɩlɑ: yɩlg-y M Roogã gilgdbã lɑ wũgdbã lɑ pʋʋsdbã yĩngɑ".

Lɑ ɑ ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm sẽn wɑ n yeele: " m Soɑbɑ! Mɑɑn yãoã tɩ yɑɑ bɑs-m-yɑm tẽngɑ, lɑ f rɩlg ɑ nebã tɩ-biis kõbg fãɑ, sẽn kõ-a sɩd bãmb pʋgẽ ne Wẽnd lɑ Lɑɑhr rɑɑrã". T'A (Wẽnd) yeele: "lɑ sẽn kɩɩsɑ, M wʋmsd-a-lɑ noog bilfu, rẽ poorẽ tɩ M veoog-ɑ n kẽng bugmã nɑngẽ. Lɑ bɑɑsg zĩig yɩ Wẽngɑ".
Lɑ ɑ ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm sẽn wɑ n zẽkd Roogã zeng-rɑɑdã lɑ ɑ ɭsmɑɑɩɩlã: " (b yetame) tõnd Soɑba! Reeg d yĩngɑ; tɩ fo yaa ɑ Wʋmda, n yɑɑ Bãngda.
Tõnd Soɑbã! Lɑ f mɑɑn tõnd tɩ d yɑɑ sɑk-n-tũ rãmbɑ lɑ tõnd Koɑmbẽ wã, tɩ yɑɑ zãmã sẽn sɑk n nɑ n tũ Foo lɑ F wĩnig tõnd d tũudmã zĩisi, lɑ F reeg d tuubgu, tɩ ɑd Foo lɑ Tuubg rεεgda, n yɑɑ Yoɑlsda.
Tõnd Soɑbɑ! Lɑ f tʋms b nengẽ, tẽn-tʋʋm sẽn yi b sʋkã t'ɑ kɑremd bãmb zug Fo aɑyɑ wã lɑ ɑ wĩnigd-b Gɑfã lɑ Bʋʋd-minim ( fɑseng dĩinã pʋgẽ) lɑ ɑ yɩlgd-bɑ, ad Foo lɑ a wilb Nɑɑbɑ n yɑɑ a Bʋʋd-Mitɑ.
Lɑ ãnd n kisgd ɑ ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm dĩinã sã n pɑ sẽn yɑlem ɑ mengɑ, lɑ hɑkɩɩkɑ Tõnd tũus-ɑ lɑme Dũni pʋgẽ, lɑ yɑoolem rɑɑrã ɑ bee nin-sõmsã pʋgẽ.
Tẽeg wɑkɑt ning a Soɑbã sẽn yeel-ɑ : "sɑk n tũ". T'a yeele : "m sɑk n tũu bõn-nɑɑndsã Soɑbã".
Lɑ a ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm sɑglɑ a koɑmbã ne gom-kãngã, ɑ Yɑɑkʋʋb me sɑglɑ a koambã n yeel-bɑ: " M koɑmba! Ad Wẽnd tũusɑ Dĩinã n kõ yãmba, bɩ y rɑ ki rẽnd tɩ y yɑɑ sɑk-n-tũ rãmbã.

Bɩ yãmb yɩɩme n yaa kɑset rãmb wɑkɑt ning kũumã sẽn wa ɑ Yɑɑkʋʋb nengẽ, ɑ sẽn wɑ n yeel ɑ koɑmbã: " bõe lɑ yãmb nɑ n tũ mɑm poorẽ?" Lɑ b yeel yã: "tõnd tũudɑ fo Soɑbã lɑ fo bɑ-rãmbã Soɑbã, ɑ ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm lɑ ɑ ɭsmɑɑɩɩl lɑ ɑ ɭshɑɑk Saobã, a yɑɑ Soɑb-n-yεng lɑ tõnd me yɑɑ sɑk-n-tũ rãmb ne-A.
Wãnde yɑɑ zãmã sẽn looge, b sẽn mɑɑn n be ne-bɑ, yãmb me sẽn mɑɑn n be ne-yã, b pɑ nɑ n sok yãmb b sẽn dɑ yɩ n tʋmdẽ wã ye.
Lɑ b yeelɑme: " Yɩ-y Yɑhʋʋd-rãmb mɑɑ Nɑsɑɑr-rãmbɑ, tɩ y na yɩ kãndgdba. Yeele: "ayae, yɑɑ a ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm Dĩinã la tõnd tũud bɑlɑ, rẽ me la wẽn-yeembgo. A pɑ yɩ n yɑɑ Lɑgem-n-tɑɑr soɑb ye".

Yeel-y: "d kõo sɩd ne Wẽnde, lɑ sẽn sik n kõ tõndã, lɑ sẽn sik n kõ a ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm lɑ ɑ ɭsmɑɑɩɩl lɑ a ɭshɑɑk lɑ a Yɑɑkuub lɑ Yɑgensã, lɑ b sẽn kõ ɑ Musɑ lɑ a ʿIisa lɑ b sẽn kõ Nɑbiyɑɑm-rãmbã sẽn yi b Soɑbã nengã wã. Tõnd pɑ welgd bɑɑ a yembr b pʋgẽ ye, tõnd me yɑɑ sɑk-n tũ rãmb ne-A.
Lɑ b sã n kõ sɩd wɑ yãmb sẽn kõ sɩdã, rẽnd b kãndgame. Lɑ b sã n raeege, rẽnd b bee yõsgr pʋgẽ, lɑ Wẽnd nɑ sek foo n yi-bɑ, bala yẽnda a yaa Wʋmd n yɑɑ Mitɑ.
Tɑbl-y Wẽnd dĩinã lɑ ãnd yɩɩd Wẽnd ne Dĩin neere, lɑ tõnd yɑɑ tũudb ne-A.
Yeel-bɑ "yãmb tɑkdɑ ne tõnd Wẽnd yellã zugu, tɩ Yẽ yɑool n yɑɑ tõnd ne yãmb Soɑba, tɩ tõnd tɑr d tʋʋm tɩ yãmb tɑr y tʋʋma. La tõnd yɑɑ pʋ-peelem rãmb ( yɩlgɑ d dĩinɑ) ne-A.

Bɩ yãmb yetɑme: "t'ɑ ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm ne a ɭsmɑɑɩɩl lɑ a ɭshɑɑk lɑ a Yɑɑkuub lɑ Yɑgensã, b rɑ yɑɑ Yɑhʋʋd-rãmbɑ bɩ Nɑsɑɑr-rãmbɑ?" Yeele : "yãmb n mi bɩ yɑɑ Wẽnde, lɑ ãnd wẽngb n yɩɩd sẽn solgɑ kɑset ɑ nengẽ sẽn yi Wẽnd nengẽ, lɑ Wẽnd pɑ yɩ n nɑ n bɑs yãmb sẽn tʋmdã ye"
Woto yɑɑ zãmã sẽn looge, b sẽn mɑɑnã n be ne-ɑ, yãmb me sẽn mɑɑnã n be ne-yã, lɑ b pɑ nɑ n sok yãmb b sẽn dɑ yɩ n tʋmdẽ wã ye.

Yɑlemsã sẽn be nebã pʋgẽ wã nɑ n yeelɑme: "bõe n wẽneg bãmbã n yi b Yɑɑng (Alkiblã) ning b sẽn dɑ be ɑ zugã, yeel: Wẽnd n so wĩnto-pusengɑ (Yɑɑng) lɑ Wĩnto-lʋɩɩngẽ, A kãndgdɑ A sẽn tʋll ɑ soɑb n tʋg so-tɩrgɑ.

Lɑ woto me lɑ D mɑɑn yãmb tɩ y yɑɑ zãmɑ sẽn tẽeg tɩrgɑ, bʋɩl yɩng tɩ y nɑ yi Seetb nebã zugu, tɩ Tẽn-tʋʋmã me yɩ Seet yãmb zugu. Lɑ Tõnd pɑ mɑɑn Yɑɑng( Alkibl) ning fo sẽn dɑ be ɑ zugã rẽndɑ D sẽn nɑ bãng ned ning sẽn pʋgd Tẽn-tʋʋmã n welg sẽn tɑrg-ɑ n leb poorẽ, lɑ ɑd ɑ wẽnegrã yɩɩme n yɑɑ pɑkre, sã n pɑ Wẽnd sẽn kãndg-b rãmbã, lɑ Wẽnd pɑ yɩ n nɑ n yeeb yãmb tʋʋmã ye, ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ Nimbãɑn-zoet n yɑɑ Yolsdɑ ne nebã.

Ad Tõnd nee fo nengã sẽn leebd Sɑɑsẽ wã (baood zĩig ning fo sẽn na n togl n pʋʋse), lɑ Tõnd nɑ n toglɑ foo Toglg zĩig f sẽn yɑrde, bɩ f toglg f nengã Lohorom-miisrã wεεgẽ, lɑ yãmb sẽn beẽ fãɑ bɩ y toglg y nemsã ɑ wεεngẽ. Lɑ ɑd b sẽn kõ-b rãmb Gɑfã miime tɩ woto yɑɑ sɩd sẽn yi b Soɑbã nengẽ, lɑ Wẽnd pɑ yɩ n nɑ n bɑs-tɩ-looge bũmb ning yãmb sẽn tʋmdã ye.

Lɑ fo sã n wa ne Aɑyɑr buud fãɑ b sẽn kõ-b rãmb Gɑfã nengẽ b kõ pʋg fo Yɑɑngã (Alkiblã) ye, lɑ fo pɑ yɩ n yɑɑ bãmb Yɑɑngã (Alkiblã) tũud ye, bãmb me pɑ yɩ n nɑ n tũ tɑɑb Alkibl ye, lɑ lɑk f sã n tũ bãmbã Yɑmleedã bãngrã sẽn wɑ fo nengẽ poore, rẽnd fo lebgɑ wẽngd mosã (f pɑ gãneg yellã ɑ zĩigẽ ye).
Tõnd sẽn kõ-b rãmb Gɑfã, b mi-ɑ lɑme wɑlɑ b sẽn mi b koɑmbã, lɑ ɑd sull n be b pʋgẽ wã n solgd sɩdã lɑ b yɑool n mi-ɑ.
Sɩdã lɑ wãnde, n yi fo Soɑbã nengẽ bɩ f rɑ yɩ sik-soɑb ye.
Lɑ yem kɑm fãɑ tɑra toglg a sẽn togende, bɩ y põsɩ-y tɑɑb ne tʋʋm-sõmse. Yãmb sẽn beẽ fãɑ Wẽnd wɑtɑ ne y gilli (bʋʋdã raare), ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ tõog Nɑɑbɑ ne bũmbã fãɑ.
Lɑ fo sẽn yiẽ fãɑ bɩ f toglg f nengã Lohorom-miisrã wεεngẽ, lɑ ɑd ɑ yɑɑ sɩd sẽn yi f Soɑbã nengẽ, lɑ Wẽnd pɑ yɩ n nɑ n bɑs bũmb ning yãmb sẽn tʋmdã ye.

Lɑ fo sẽn yiẽ fãɑ bɩ f toglg f nengã Lohorom-miisrã wεεngẽ, lɑ yãmb sẽn beẽ fãɑ bɩ y togl y nensã ɑ wεεngẽ, bʋɩl yĩng tɩ sẽn nɑ n yeelg rɑ zĩnd ne nebã yãmb zug ye. Sã n pɑ sẽn yɑ-b wẽgdb b pʋgẽ wã, bɩ y rɑ yεεs-y-b ye, lɑ y yεεs-y Mɑɑm, tɩ M pids M neema wã yãmb zugu, tɩ y nɑ kãndge.
(Yaa woto bala) La Tõnd tʋms yãmb nengẽ Tẽn-tʋʋm sẽn yi yãmb pʋgẽ t'ɑ kɑremd yãm zug Tõnd Aɑyɑyã lɑ ɑ yɩlgd yãmb lɑ a wĩnigd yãmb Gɑfã lɑ bʋʋd-minim (sũnnɑ) lɑ a wĩnigd yãmb y sẽn dɑ pɑ miẽ.
Bɩ y tẽeg M Yʋʋrã tɩ M nɑ tẽeg y yelle, lɑ y pʋʋs Mɑɑm bɑrk lɑ y rɑ mɑɑn Sõm-zɩtem ne Mɑɑm ye.
Yɑɑ yãmb neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd ne Wẽnde! kos-y sõngr ne sugr mɑɑneg lɑ pʋʋsgo, ɑd Wẽnd lɑgma sugrã rãmbã.
Lɑ y rɑ yeel tɩ b sẽn kʋ-b rãmb Wẽnd sorã zug "tɩ yɑɑ kiidb ye". Ayae! B yɑɑ vɩtbɑ, lɑ ɑd y pɑ vẽen ne rẽ ye.
Lɑ D nɑ zɑrb yãmb n ges ne bũmb ning sẽn yɑɑ rɑbeem (yεεsgo), lɑ kom, lɑ boogr sẽn yi arzεgsẽ lɑ yõyã lɑ tɩ-biisi, lɑ f noog sugrã rãmb sũyã.
B rãmb nins tɩ masɩɩb (pɑkr) sã n pɑɑm-b lɑ b sẽn yete: "tõnd yɑɑ Wẽnd soolem d lebr zĩig me yɑɑ A nengẽ".
Bãmbã Pʋʋsg be ne-bɑ, sẽn yi b Soɑbã nengẽ lɑ Yolsgo, lɑ bãmb me lɑ kãngdbɑ.

Ad Ṣɑfɑɑ ne Mɑrwɑɑ bee Wẽnd Sãri wã tɑgmas-rãmb pʋgẽ, rẽnd sẽn kɑɑg-ɑ (Mɑk) Roogã wal ɑ mɑɑnɑ ʿƲmrɑ yell kɑ be ne-ɑ t'ɑ gilg b yiibã ye, lɑ sẽn mɑɑnɑ Nɑɑfɩl (pɑɑsg) sõmã pʋgẽ fãɑ rẽnd Wẽnd yɑɑ Bɑrk pʋʋsd n yɑa Mitɑ.
Rãmb nins sẽn solgd bũmb ning Tõnd sẽn sikã sẽn yɑɑ vẽenesã lɑ kãndgrã, Tõnd sẽn vẽneg-ɑ n kõ nebã poorẽ Gɑfã pʋgẽ, bãmbã lɑ Wẽnd sẽn kãɑbdã, tɩ kãɑbdbã kãɑbd-ba.
Rẽnda sẽn tuub-bã, lɑ b mɑneg b tʋʋmã, lɑ b vẽnege (sɩdã bãmb sẽn solgã). bãmbã, M reegda b tuubgu, Mɑɑm lɑ a Tuubg rεεgdɑ n yɑɑ Yosldɑ.
Neb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã lɑ kell n mɑɑn kɑɑlem tɩ b yɑɑ sõm-zɩtbã (kɩfendãmbã) , bãmb lɑ Wẽnd Kãɑbgã sẽn be ne wã, lɑ Mɑlεgsã lɑ nebã fãɑ (kãabgo).
Tɩ b yɑɑ ruumdb ɑ pʋgẽ, b pɑ nɑ n yols naongã b zugu, b pɑ nɑ n ges-bɑ ( b pɑ nɑ n koll-bɑ).
Lɑ yãmb Soɑbã yɑɑ Soɑb-yεng, soɑb kɑ be tɩ sã n pɑ Yẽ ye. A yɑɑ a Dũni yolsdɑ n yɑɑ a Lɑɑhr yolsdɑ.

Ad Sɑɑsã lɑ Tẽngã nɑɑneg pʋgẽ, lɑ yʋngã ne wĩndgã yõs-tɑɑbã pʋgẽ, lɑ kogend nins sẽn zoet mogrã zug ne bũmb nins sẽn nɑfd nebã, lɑ Wẽnd sẽn sik Sɑɑsẽ wã n vɩɩms tẽngã ne-ɑ ɑ sẽn ki poorẽ wã, lɑ ɑ sãeeg ɑ pʋgẽ bõn-yãnemdɩ fãɑ wã, lɑ sebdã fugbã lɑ sɑwɑtã b sẽn nom-ɑ n yals sɑɑsã lɑ tẽnsã sʋkã, wã fãa yɑɑ yel-soalemɑ ne neb nins sẽn tɑr yɑmã.

Lɑ bee nebã pʋgẽ, neb sẽn gãd soben-dãmb zẽms sẽn pɑ Wẽnde, n nong-b wɑlɑ Wẽnd nonglem, lɑ ɑd sẽn kõ-b sɩdã, bãmb wẽndã nonglem keelem n yɩɩd bãmb sẽn nong b soben-dãmbã. Lɑ lɑk wẽgdbã sã n dɑ yãtẽ b halhɑɑlã, bãmb sẽn wɑt n yã nɑngã sasa, (b bãngdame) tɩ pãng fãɑ yɑɑ Wẽnd n so. Lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ nɑms-kεgeng soɑbɑ.
B sẽn n pʋg-b rãmbã sẽn wɑt n zãag b mens ne sẽn pʋg-b bãmb tɩ b yã nɑngã mɑsã, tɩ tõk-n-taarã ne bãmb sʋkã wãɑge.
Tɩ pʋgdbã yeele: " lɑk tõnd sã n dɑ tɑrẽ lεbeng zĩig tõogo, d na zãag-bɑ wɑlɑ b sẽn zãag tõndã, yɑɑ woto lɑ Wẽnd winigd bãmb b tʋʋmã wẽngɑ, tɩ yɑɑ bõn ne-bɑ, b pɑ nɑ n yi bugmẽ wã ye.
Yɑɑ yãmb ɑ nebɑ! rɩ-y sẽn be tẽngã zug n yɑɑ Hɑlɑɑl n yɑɑ Yɩlgemdã lɑ y rɑ pʋg ɑ Sʋtãan nɑo ye, ɑd ɑ yɑɑ bε sẽn yɑɑ vẽenegɑ ne yãmbɑ.
Ad ɑ sɑgendɑ yãmb ne wẽng lɑ yel-beedo, lɑ (tusd yãmb) sẽn na yɩlẽ tɩ yãmb yeel Wẽnd zug y sẽn pɑ mi.

Lɑ b sã n yeel bãmbɑ: " tũ-y Wẽnd sẽn sikã" lɑ b sẽn yete: "ɑyo'o tõnd pʋgdɑ d sẽn mik d bɑ-rãmbã ne bũmb ningã" lɑ bɑɑ tɩ bãmb bɑ-rãmb sã n pɑ mi fʋɩ lɑ b pɑ paam kãndgre bãmb nɑ n kell n tũud-b lɑme bɩ?.
Lɑ rãmb nins sẽn kɩfl-bã bilgr yɑɑ wɑlɑ ned sẽn moond n boond sẽn pɑ wʋmdɑ fʋɩ tɩ sã n pɑ mooneg lɑ boaal bʋrg bɑlɑ ye. B yɑɑ wʋmse, n yɑɑ mugsi, n yɑɑ zoense, b pɑ fɑsemd ye.
Yɑɑ yãmb sẽn kõ-b sɩdɑ! rɩ-y bõn-yɩlmɑ tõnd sẽn rɩlg yãmbã lɑ y pʋʋs Wẽnd bɑrk tɩ sã n yɑɑ Yẽ lɑ y tũudã.

Ad A gɩdgɑ yãmb zugu : Gifa, zɩɩm lɑ kurkur nemdo, lɑ b sẽn kodg ne sẽn pɑ Wẽnd yʋʋre. Lɑ sẽn pɑkɑ soɑb t'ɑ pɑ kedgd la pɑ mɑɑn-n-zʋʋg soɑbɑ, rẽnd zũunuub kɑ ɑ zug ye, ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ Yɑɑfdɑ n yɑɑ Yolsdɑ.
Ad sẽn solgd-b Wẽnd sẽn sik Gɑfẽ wã, lɑ b tekd-ɑ ne ligd bilfã, bãmbã pɑ rɩt b pʋsẽ wã rẽndɑ bugum, lɑ Wẽnd pɑ gomd ne-b yikrã rɑɑr ye, A pɑ yɩlgd-bɑ, b tɑrɑ nɑmsg sẽn zɑbde.
Bãmbã lɑ sẽn tek kãndgrã ne menengo, lɑ Yɑɑfgã ne Nɑmesgo, ɑd bãmb sugr mɑɑneg bugmã pʋgẽ pɑ tɑr to ye.
Lɑ rẽndɑ yɑɑ tɩ Wẽnd sikɑ Gɑfã ne sɩdɑ, lɑ ɑd sẽn yõs-b tɑɑb Gɑfã pʋgẽ wã, b bee welg-tɑɑb sẽn zãɑg ne sɩdã.

Mɑnegrã pɑ yãmb toglg y nemsã Yɑɑng (wĩnt-pusegrẽ) mɑɑ Winto-lʋɩtgẽ ye, la ɑd mɑnegrã yɑɑ kõ sɩd ne Wẽnd lɑ Lɑɑhr rɑɑrã, lɑ kõ sɩd ne Mɑlεgsã, lɑ Gɑfã, lɑ Nɑbiyɑɑm-rãmbã, lɑ kõ arzεkã ne ɑ sẽn nong-ɑ wã fãɑ ɑ rog-pẽtbɑ, lɑ kɩɩbse, lɑ nim-bãɑn-dãmbɑ, lɑ kẽn-kẽnda, lɑ bõosdbɑ, lɑ yembd yidgri, lɑ ɑ yãnes ne pʋʋsg lɑ ɑ kõ Zɑkɑ, lɑ sẽn pidsd-b pʋlengã tɩ b sã n pʋlme, lɑ sugr maaneg tɑlemd lɑ nɑmsg lɑ keelem wɑkɑto. Bãmb lɑ sẽn sɩdg-bã, bãmbã lɑ Wẽn-zoetbã.

Yɑɑ yãmb rãmb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩdɑ! B roglɑ yãmb mɑɑn-n-dolg kʋʋdbẽ wã, burkĩn yɑɑ burkĩn n donde, yamb ne yambɑ, pag ne pɑgɑ, rẽnd b sẽn yɑɑf ɑ soɑbɑ bũmb ningɑ, bɩ b pʋg ne mɑnegr n deeg yõorã yɑoodo; lɑ kʋʋdã me kɩs ne mɑneg-n-pɑɑse, ɑd wãnde yɑɑ boogr sẽn yi yãmb Soɑbã nengẽ lɑ yolsgo, lɑ sẽn mɑɑnɑ n zʋʋg toog rẽ poorẽ, ɑ tɑr nɑmsg sẽn zɑbde.
Lɑ yãmb tɑrɑ vɩɩm mɑɑn-n-dolã pʋgẽ, yɑɑ yãmb yɑm-bεεl rãmbɑ, tɩ y nɑ zoe Wẽnde.
B gʋlsɑme n dogl yãmb zugu, tɩ kũum sã n wa yãmb yembr fãɑ nengẽ, ɑ sã n bɑs arzεkɑ, bɩ ɑ bɑs no-gomde, rogdb ɑ yiibã yĩngɑ lɑ rog-pẽtse, ne sẽn be neere tɩ b miẽ, tɩ yɑɑ hɑkε n zɑo Wẽn-zoetbã.
Lɑ sẽn tedgɑ ɑ sẽn wʋm-ɑ wã poorẽ, rẽnd ɑ yel-beedã bee ne neb nins sẽn tedgd-ɑ wã, ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ Wʋmd n yɑa Mitɑ.

Lɑ yãmb sã n sɑ Hɑgiimdã tʋʋmã bɩ y tẽeg Wẽnd yelle wɑlɑ y bɑ-rãmbã yell tẽegre, mɑɑ sẽn yɩɩd rẽ. Bɑlɑ be nebã pʋgẽ sẽn yete: "tõnd Soɑbɑ kõ tõnd Dũni" . Lɑ bãmb yɑool n pɑ tɑr bɑɑ fʋɩ Yɑoolem dɑɑrã ye.

Bãmbã tɑrɑ pʋɩɩr b sẽn tʋmã, lɑ Wẽnd Geelg yɑɑ Tʋʋlle.

Lɑ y tẽeg Wẽnd yʋʋrã rɑsem-rãmb sɑɑre, lɑ sẽn yãga n lebg rɑsem a yiib pʋgẽ zunũub kɑe ɑ pʋgẽ ye, lɑ sẽn yɑoolɑ, yell pɑ be ɑ zugu, ne sã n zoe Wẽnd ye. Lɑ y zoe Wẽnd lɑ y bãng tɩ ɑd b nɑ n tigim-y lɑme n tʋg A nengẽ.
Lɑ be nebã pʋgẽ koεεg sẽn mɑɑn foo yel-solemd Dũni vɩɩmã pʋgẽ, n mɑɑnd Wẽnd ɑ kɑset ne sẽn be ɑ sũurẽ wã -zĩri-beedo- lɑ ɑ yɑool n yɑɑ zɑbd-n-tɑɑg sẽn yɑɑ kεgengɑ ( zɑb-toog soɑbɑ).

Lɑ bee nebã pʋgẽ sẽn koosd b mense Wẽnd Yɑrdã bɑoob pʋgẽ lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ Nimbãɑn-zoet ne A Yembsã.

Lɑ y rɑ fur lɑgem-n-tɑ-pogsã hɑl tɩ b wɑ kõ sɩdɑ, ɑd yamb-poɑk sẽn yɑa sɩd-kõt n são Lɑgem-n-tɑ-poɑkɑ, bɑ t'ɑ sã n mɑɑn yãmb yel-solmde, lɑ y rɑ fur n kõ kɩfr-dɑɑdã hɑl tɩ b wɑ kõ sɩdɑ, ɑd yambɑ sẽn yɑɑ sɩd-kõtɑ n são kɩfr hɑl t'ɑ sã n mɑɑn yãmb yel-soalmɑ, bãmb lɑ sẽn bood n togd bugmã, lɑ Wẽnd boodɑme n tʋgd Arzãnɑ lɑ Yɑɑfɑ ne A rɑɑbo, lɑ ɑ vẽnesdɑ A Aɑyɑ wã ne nebã, tɩ b nɑ tɑgs n tẽege

Rɑ mɑɑn-y y wẽenegã ne Wẽndã, tɩ gɩdgd yãmb ne mɑnegre, bɩ ne Wẽn-zoεεgɑ, bɩ ne mɑneg nebã ne tɑɑb sʋkɑ, lɑ Wẽnd yɑa wʋmdɑ n yɑɑ Mitɑ.

Lɑ b sã n loe furã kɑoobo Wẽnd yɑɑ Wʋmdɑ n yɑa Mitɑ.

Lɑ fur sẽn kɑo-bã, b zĩndedɑ b mens yĩng kiuug a tãɑbo, lɑ pɑ sõmb ne-b tɩ b solg Wẽnd sẽn nɑɑn b rogsẽ wã ye, tɩ b sã n kõo sɩd ne Wẽnd lɑ Yɑoolem dɑɑrã. Fur kɑoob yɑɑ noor ɑ yiibu, rẽ poore yɑɑ b gãd-a mɑɑ b bɑs-ɑ ne mɑɑn-neere. Lɑ pɑ sõmb ne yãmbɑ tɩ y reeg yãmb sẽn kõ-bã bɑɑ fʋɩ, sã n pɑ b yiibã n tẽed tɩ b yiibã pɑ nɑ n tõog n yãnes ne Wẽnd Todsã, ɑ sẽn kis rɑoã yĩngɑ. Rẽnd yãmb sã n yɑεεsd tɩ b pɑ nɑ n tõog n gũus Wẽnd Todsã, rẽnd yell kɑ be b yiibã zugu pɑgã sẽn nɑ n yɑo ɑ sɩdã n soog ɑ mengã, wãnde yɑɑ Wẽnd todse bɩ y rɑ gãndg-b ye, lɑ sẽn zʋʋg-b Wẽnd Todsã bãmbã lɑ wẽgdbã.

Lɑ ɑ sã n kɑo ɑ furi ɑ pɑ le yɑɑ hɑlɑɑl ne rɑoã hɑlɩ t'ɑ wɑ fur sɩd ɑ to, tɩ yẽ sã n kɑo ɑ furã, yell pɑ be ne b yiibã tɩ b leb tɑɑb nengẽ ne fur pɑɑlle, tɩ b yiibã sã n tẽed tɩ b nɑ n tõog n yɑlsɑ ne Wẽnd todsã, lɑ wãnde yɑɑ Wẽnd todse t'A vẽnegd-b ne mitbã.

Lɑ yãmb sã n kɑo pɑgbã furi tɩ b zĩnd ɭddɑ tɩ sɑ, bɩ y gãd-bɑ ne mɑnegre mɑɑ y bɑs-bɑ ne mɑnegre, lɑ y rɑ gãd-b n nɑ nɑms-b bɑl ye, lɑ sẽn mɑɑnɑ rẽ, ɑ wẽgɑ ɑ mengɑ, lɑ y rɑ rɩk Wẽnd Aɑyɑyã ne yɑɑlg ye, lɑ y tẽeg Wẽnd neemɑ wã yãmb zugã lɑ A sẽn sik yãmb zugu sẽn yɑɑ Gɑfã lɑ Sʋnnã n sɑgend yãmb ne-ba, lɑ y zoe Wẽnde lɑ y bãng tɩ Wẽnd yɑɑ Mitɑ ne bũmb fãɑ.

Lɑ yãmb sã n bɑs pɑgbã tɩ b sɑ b Zĩndgã, bɩ y rɑ yeeb-y-bɑ tɩ b rɑ fur b sɩdbã tɩ b sã n yɑr tɑɑbɑ mɑnegr pʋgẽ ye, wãnde lɑ b sɑgend sẽn be ɑ yãmb pʋgẽ n kõt sɩd ne Wẽnde lɑ Yɑoolem rɑɑrã, wãnde n yɩɩd nɑfɑ ne yãmbɑ lɑ yɩlgre, lɑ Wẽnd miime lɑ yãmb pɑ mi ye.

Lɑ mɑ-rãmbã yẽsemdɑ b koɑmbã yʋʋm ɑ yiib sẽn pidi, sẽn tʋllɑ n nɑ n pids yẽsengã, lɑ b sẽn dog ɑ soɑb yĩngã (baabã wã) n nɑ n rɩlg-bɑ lɑ ɑ yeelg-bɑ n zemse, Wẽnd pɑ rogend yõore rẽndɑ ɑ sẽn tõe, b rɑ nɑms mɑ wã ɑ biigã sɑbɑb ye, pɑ sɑɑmbã me ɑ biigã yĩng ye, lɑ sẽn rɩkdɑ biigã fɑɑdã t'ɑ sɑɑmbã sã n kɑ be wã, yẽ me bʋʋdã yɑɑ wɑlɑ sɑɑmbã bɑlɑ, lɑ roɑgdbã yiibã sã n dɑt n yãk biigã bĩisim bɩ yɩ b yiibã yɑrdɑ, lɑ b mɑɑn tɑɑb sɑɑwɑre, rẽnd yell kɑ be ne b yiibã ye, lɑ yãmb sã n dɑt n kõ y koɑmbã tɩ b yẽsme yell kɑe ne yãmbɑ tɩ yãmb sã n kɩs yãmb sẽn nɑ n kɩsã ne mɑnegre, lɑ y zoe Wẽnde lɑ y bãng tɩ Wẽnd yɑɑ Netɑ ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.

Lɑ sẽn maan-b kaalem yãmb pʋgẽ n bɑs pɑgbɑ, b zĩndidɑ b mens yĩngɑ kiuus a nɑɑse lɑ rɑsem piigɑ, lɑ b sã n sɑ b zĩndgã rẽnd yell kɑ be ne yãmbɑ b sẽn mɑɑn ɑ soɑb n zemsã tɩ yɑɑ mɑnegre, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ Kibɑr-mini Nɑɑbɑ ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.

Lɑ yell pɑ be ne yãmbɑ yãmb sẽn bɩnd bũmb ningɑ sẽn yɑɑ pɑgbã beleng ye, mɑɑ y solgɑ y mensẽ n dɑt-bɑ. Wẽnd bãngɑme tɩ yãmb nɑ n tẽegɑ b yelle lɑ rɑ pʋlemd-y-b tẽngr-tẽngr tɩ y nɑ n fur-b lɑme ye, sã n pɑ mɑnegr koεεg bɑlɑ, lɑ y rɑ nɑdg ne furã loeegɑ hɑlɩ tɩ zĩndgã wɑ sɑ, lɑ y bãng tɩ Wẽnd mii sẽn be ne yãmbã, bɩ y gũus-A lɑ y bãng tɩ Wẽnde yɑɑ Yɑɑfdɑ n yɑɑ Tõog-m-meng Soɑbɑ.

Yell pɑ be ne yãmb tɩ yãmb sã n bɑs pɑgbã tɩ y sã n pɑ pɑɑm n sɩɩs-bɑ mɑa y pʋd furã ligd b yĩngɑ, bɩ y kõ-bɑ b sẽn na sõng b mense. Tõog soab ne a sẽn tõe, keelem soɑb me ne ɑ sẽn tõe, tɩ yɑɑ wʋmsem-noogo sẽn zemse, tɩ yɑɑ hɑkε n zɑo mɑnegdbã zugu.

Lɑ yãmb sã n kɑo b furã tɑoor tɩ yãmb nɑn pɑ sɩɩs-bɑ lɑ yãmb yɑool n kõ-b-lɑ furã ligdi, rẽnd yɑɑ furã ligd pʋsʋkɑ sã n pɑ pagbã n yɑɑfe mɑɑ furã loεεg sẽn be ɑ soɑb nugẽ wã n yɑɑfe, lɑ yãmb sã n bɑse, rẽ n pẽ ne wẽn-zoεεgɑ, lɑ y rɑ yĩm sõama maaneg yãmb ne tɑɑb sʋk ye, ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ Netɑ ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.
Gũus-y pʋʋs-rãmbã lɑ sʋk pʋʋsgã (Lɑɑnsɑrã Pʋʋsgã), lɑ y yãnes ne Pʋʋsgã, Wẽnd a ye yĩngɑ, tɩ y yɑɑ gãneg-m-mens rãmbɑ ( Wẽnd tũudbɑ).
Lɑ yãmb sã n yεεsd bεεb bɩ y pʋʋs tɩ y yɑɑ kẽndbɑ, mɑɑ zoɑmdbɑ, lɑ yãmb sã n pɑɑm bɑs-m-yɑm, bɩ y tẽeg Wẽnd yelle wɑlɑ A sẽn wilg yãmbɑ, yãmb sẽn dɑ pɑ mi wã.

Lɑ sẽn maand-b kaalmã yãmb pʋgẽ n bɑs b pɑgbã bɩ b bɑs no-gomde b pɑgbã yĩngɑ tɩ b zĩnd zɑgsẽ wã n mɑɑnd b rɑɑb n tãag yʋʋmde n dɑ yiis-b ye, lɑ b sã n yi b toore yell pɑ be ne yãmbɑ b sẽn mɑɑn ne b mensã sã n yɑɑ mɑnegre, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ Wilb Nɑɑbɑ n yɑɑ Bʋʋd-Mitɑ.
Lɑ b sẽn kɑo-b rãmb furã me tɑrɑ wʋm-noogo sẽn zemse, tɩ zɑo wẽn-zoεtbã zugu.
Yɑɑ woto lɑ Wẽnd vẽnesd A Aɑyɑ wã ne yãmbɑ tɩ y nɑ pɑɑm yɑm.
Fo pɑ ne neb nins sẽn yi-b zɑgsẽ wã, tɩ bãmb yɑɑ tus-tusɑ kũumã zoees yĩnga, tɩ Wẽnd yeel-bɑ : "ki-y! " rẽ poor t'A vʋʋg-bɑ, ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ Kũun-bedr Soɑb ne nebã lɑ ɑd nebã wʋsg pɑ pʋʋsd bɑrk ye.
Lɑ y zɑb Wẽnd Sorã pʋgẽ lɑ y bãng tɩ Wẽnd yɑɑ Wʋmdɑ n yɑɑ Mitɑ.
Ãnd soɑb n nɑ n peng Wẽnd pengr sẽn be neere, t'A fão-a ɑ yĩng fãoob wʋsgo, lɑ Wẽnd n yõbgd lɑ A yɑlgdẽ, lɑ y lεbeng zĩig yɑɑ A nengẽ.

Fo pɑ ne zãma wã sẽn yi ɭsrɑɑɩɩl koɑmbẽ wã, ɑ Musɑ loogr poorẽ, b sẽn wɑ n yeel b nɑbiyɑɑmã:" yãk nɑɑb n kõ-do tɩ d zɑb Wẽnd Sorã yĩngɑ". T'ɑ yeele :"rẽ yĩngɑ b sã n dogl yãmb zɑbrã, y pɑ nɑ n tõdg tɩ y kõn n zɑbe". Tɩ b yeele : "yɑɑ bõe n tɑr tõnd tɩ d pɑ nɑ n zɑb Wẽnd Dĩinã poorẽ, tɩ bεεbã yɑool n yiisɑ tõnd d zɑgsẽ lɑ d koɑmbẽ?" Lɑ b sẽn wɑ n gʋls zɑbrã n dogl-bã lɑ b sẽn gũd b zãn-kuds sã n pɑ bilf bɑlɑ sẽn yi bãmb pʋgẽ wã, lɑ ɑd Wẽnd mii Wẽgdbã.

Tɩ b Nɑbiyɑɑmã yeel-bɑ:" ɑd Wẽnd tʋmsa ɑ Toaalʋʋt tɩ yɑɑ nɑɑbɑ, tɩ b yeele: "ɑ nɑ n tɑllɑ nɑɑm tõnd zug wãn-wãnɑ, tɩ tõnd n sõmb ne nɑɑm n yɩɩd-ɑ, lɑ ɑ pɑ tɑr arzεk wʋsgo?" T'ɑ yeele: "ɑd Wẽnd n tũus-ɑ-lɑ yãmb zugu, lɑ A kõ-a bãng-yɑlengɑ, lɑ yĩngɑ, lɑ Wẽnd kõtɑ A nɑɑmã A sẽn tʋll ɑ soɑbɑ, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ kõ-yɑleng Soɑbɑ n yɑa Mitɑ.

Tɩ b Nɑbiyɑɑmã yeel-bɑ: "ɑd ɑ nɑɑmã tɑgemse yɑɑ koglgã sẽn nɑ n wɑ yãmb nengẽ, tɩ yĩ-yõgneg be ɑ pʋgẽ sẽn yi yãmb Soɑbẽ wã, lɑ ɑ Musɑ zɑk rãmb lɑ ɑ Hɑɑrʋʋn zɑk rãmb te-kεlɑ, tɩ Mɑlεgsã zãɑd-bɑ, ɑd tɑgems be rẽ pʋgẽ ne yãmbɑ tɩ y sã n yɑɑ sɩd-kõtbɑ".

Lɑ ɑ Toɑalʋʋt sẽn wɑ n fãsg ne tãpã ɑ yeelɑme: ɑd Wẽnd nɑ n zɑrbɑ yãmb ne kʋɩlgɑ, lɑ sẽn yũ-ɑ, ɑ pɑ pʋgd mɑɑm ye, lɑ sẽn pɑ lεmb-ɑ, yẽ n be ne mɑɑm, sã n pɑ sẽn kɑrg-ɑ bilfu ne ɑ nug bɑlɑ". Lɑ b yũ-ɑ lɑme sã n pɑ b neb sãɑr bɑlɑ. Lɑ ɑ sẽn wɑ n gãndg-ɑ wã yẽndɑ lɑ sɩd-kõtbã, b yeelɑme: "tõog pɑ be ne tõnd rũndã ne ɑ Gεεlʋʋt lɑ ɑ tãpã ye". Lɑ sẽn tɑr-b bãng-n-wãak tɩ bãmb nɑ n yekɑ Wẽndã yeelɑme: "sõor wɑoog zãmɑ bilf sẽn wil zãmɑ wʋsg ne Wẽnd tõogo, lɑ ɑd Wẽnd bee ne sugr rãmbɑ".
Lɑ b sẽn wɑ n puk ne ɑ Gεεlʋʋt lɑ ɑ tãpã, lɑ b sẽn yeele: d Soɑb ɑ Wẽnde! kiig tõnd sugri, lɑ F tɑblg tõnd nɑ-tɑgdɩ wã, lɑ F sõng tõnd kɩfr-rɑmbã zugu".

Tɩ b tõog-bɑ ne Wẽnd tõogo t'ɑ Dɑɑwʋʋd kʋ ɑ Gεεlʋʋt tɩ Wẽnd kõ-ɑ nɑɑmã lɑ nɑbiyɑɑmdlemã lɑ A wĩnig-ɑ ɑ sẽn tʋll fãɑ sẽn yɑɑ bãngr kõbg toor-toore, lɑ sã n pɑ Wẽnd sẽn tusd nebã wẽngã sẽn tũ ne neb ɑ tɑɑbã nugã, tẽngã nɑan n sãɑmẽ. Lɑ ɑd Wẽnd yɑɑ yɩɩdlem Soɑb bõn-nɑɑndsã zugu.
Wãnde yɑɑ Wẽnd Aɑyɑy tɩ D kɑremd-b yãmb zug ne sɩdɑ, Lɑ ɑd fo bee tẽn-tʋʋmdbã pʋgẽ.

Tẽn-tʋʋmb nins yell Tõnd sẽn togsã, Tõnd yɩɩs-b-lɑ tɑɑbɑ, be b pʋgẽ Wẽnd sẽn gom ne, lɑ A zẽk b sãndɑ ziiri, lɑ Tõnd kõo ɑ ʿIisa ɑ Mɑryɑm biigã vẽenese lɑ D kεng ɑ pεlgɑ ne Yõ-yɩleng ɑ Gibriil, lɑ Wẽnd sã n tʋllẽ sẽn wɑ-b bãmb poorẽ wã kõon n zɑbẽ tɑɑba, vẽenesã sẽn wɑ bãmb nengẽ wã poorẽ ye. Lɑ ɑd b yõsɑ tɑɑbɑ. Be b pʋgẽ wã sẽn kõ sɩdɑ, be be sẽn kɩfle, lɑ Wẽnd sã n tʋllẽ b kõon n zɑbẽ ne tɑɑb ye, lɑ ɑd yɑɑ Wẽnd n mɑɑnd A sẽn dɑte.
Yɑɑ yãmb sẽn kõ-b sɩdɑ! yãk-y Tõnd sẽn dɩlg yãmbã n nɑf tɑoor tɩ rɑɑr nɑn pɑ wɑ koosem sẽn kɑ be, pɑ zoodo, pɑ sũgsgu, lɑ kɩfr-dãmbã, bãmb lɑ wẽgbã.

Wẽnde, soɑb sẽn tũud n tɩlg kɑ be tɩ sã n pɑ Yẽ ye, A yɑɑ Vɩta, vɩɩm sẽn-pid-Soɑbɑ, n yɑɑ a Mɑɑn-m-toor Soɑbɑ (yãs ne yembsɑ yεlã rɑbsgo), gõeem pɑ yõnkd-A, pɑ Suusgu. A soo sẽn be sɑɑsẽ wã lɑ sẽn be Tẽngẽ wã, ãnd n nɑ n sugs A nengẽ tɩ sã n pɑ ne A yɑrdɑ, A mii sẽn be bãmb neng tɑoor lɑ b poorẽ, lɑ bãmb pɑ tõe gũbg A bãngrã bɑɑ fʋɩ, sã n pɑ A sẽn tʋll tɩ b bãngã, A nɑɑmã goeel tɑgr zĩigẽ yãmbɑ sɑɑsã lɑ tẽngã, lɑ b yiibã (sɑɑgɑ lɑ tẽngã) gũubu pɑ sẽn weoog Wẽnd ye, lɑ Yẽ yɑɑ Zẽkr-Nɑɑbɑ n yɑɑ Zɩsgo.
Modgr pɑ be dĩinã pʋgẽ ye, ɑd sɩdã kãndgrã vẽnegɑme n welg ne kedgrã, lɑ sẽn kɩfla ne sʋtãɑn fãɑ lɑ a kõ sɩd ne Wẽnde, rẽnd ɑ gãdɑ wĩir sẽn kegme, sẽn pɑ tɑr tõsgr ye, lɑ Wẽnd yɑa Wʋmdɑ n yɑɑ Mitɑ.
Wẽnd lɑ sɩd-kõtbã lɑlldɑ, A yiisdɑ bãmb ligsẽ wã n tʋgd vẽenmẽ wã, lɑ sẽn kɩfl-bã bãmb lɑlldb yɑɑ rʋbsã, b yiisdɑ bãmb vẽenmẽ wã n tʋgd ligsẽ wã, bãmb lɑ bugmã koɑmbɑ, b yɑɑ duumdb ɑ pʋgẽ.

Fo pɑ yã sẽn wẽedɑ no-kεεm ne ɑ ɭbrɑhɩɩm ɑ soɑbã yellẽ tɩ Wẽnd n kõ-a nɑɑm. Wɑkɑt ning ɑ ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm sẽn yeele: " mɑm Soɑbã lɑ sẽn vʋɩɩmsd lɑ A kʋʋdɑ". Lɑ a yeel yã: "mɑm vʋɩɩmsdɑme lɑ m kʋʋdɑ". Lɑ ɑ ɭbrɑɑhɩɩm yeel yã: " lɑ Wẽnd wɑtɑ ne wĩndgã ɑ sẽn pukdẽ wã, bɩ fo wa ne-ɑ t'ɑ puk ɑ sẽn lʋɩtẽ wã" .Tɩ sẽn kɩfla wã yirbi, lɑ ɑd Wẽnd pɑ peegd neb sẽn yɑɑ wẽgdb ye.

Maa fo yãɑ wɑlɑ sẽn pɩʋʋgɑ tẽngã t'ɑ yɑɑ sẽn kɑo n zam tɑɑbɑ, t'ɑ yeele: "tẽn-kãngã, Wẽnd nɑ n vɩɩms-a-lɑ wãn-wãn ɑ kũumã poorẽ?" Tɩ Wẽnd kʋ-ɑ yʋʋm koɑbgɑ, n lebg n vʋʋg-ɑ, la Wẽnd yeele: "wɑkɑt wãn lɑ f zĩnd yã?" Lɑ ɑ yeel yã: "m zĩndɑ rɑɑr mɑɑ rɑɑr pʋsʋkɑ". t'A yeele: Pa woto ye, ad fo zĩnda yʋʋm koabga, bɩ f ges fo rɩɩbã la f koomã pa tedg ye, la ges f bõangã, bʋɩl yĩng tɩ D na maan foom tɩ yaa yel-solemd ne nebã. La ges kõabã Tõnd sẽn wεεl-b to-to, rẽ poorẽ tɩ D pil-b nemdo. La ɑ sẽn yã rẽ wã sɩdã vẽnegɑ ne-a, t'a yeele: " m bãngame tɩ Wẽnd yaa Tõog Nɑɑb ne bũmbã fãa".

Lɑ tẽeg wɑkat ning ɑ ɭbrɑɑgɩɩm sẽn yeele: " m Soɑbɑ! wĩnig mɑɑm F sẽn vʋʋgd kũum to-to". T'A yeele: " f pɑ kõ sɩd lɑ?" T'ɑ yeele: "ɑyo! M kõo sɩdɑ, yɑɑ sẽn nɑ yɩl tɩ m sũurã yõgne". T'A yeele: bɩ f yõg liuuli ɑ nɑɑs n kʋʋs-b n kɑlem tɑɑba, rẽ poore bɩ f ning tãng fãɑ zug bεkɑ, rẽ poorẽ bɩ f bool-bɑ tɩ b nɑ wɑ fo nengẽ ne yãgbo, lɑ f bãng tɩ Wẽnd yɑɑ Windɑ n yɑɑ Bʋʋd-Mitɑ.
Sẽn nɑfd b ɑrzεgs Wẽnd sorã pʋgẽ wã bilgri, yɑɑ wɑlɑ bõn-beel sẽn wom zut ɑ yopoe, zug fãɑ pʋgẽ yɑa bεεl koɑbg n be be, lɑ Wẽnd fãoodɑ A sẽn tʋll ɑ soɑbɑ, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ kõ-yɑleng Soɑbɑ n yɑɑ Mitɑ.
Sẽn yãkd b arzεgsã n nɑfdẽ Wẽnd sorã pʋgẽ, rẽ poorẽ tɩ b pɑ pogend b kũunã ne tãɑsgo mɑa nɑmsgo, bãmb tɑrɑ b keoor b Soɑbã nengẽ tɩ rɑbeem kɑ be ne bãmbɑ, b kõn n sãɑm b sũy me.
Koεεg sẽn mɑneg lɑ yɑɑf-n-bɑse, ɑ sõmblem yɩɩdɑ doaɑg (kũuni) nɑmsg sẽn tũnugd-ɑ, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ Sek-m-meng Soɑbɑ n yɑɑ sugr Soɑbɑ

Yɑɑ yãmb ɑ sɩd-kõtbɑ! Rɑ n sãɑm-y y doosã ne tãɑsg lɑ nɑmsg ye, wɑlɑ sẽn kõt ɑ arzεk nebã nɑ yã yĩnga, n yaool pɑ kõt sɩd ne Wẽnde lɑ Yɑoolem dɑɑrã ye. Yẽ bilgr yɑɑ wɑlɑ kug-lɑɑg tom sẽn be ɑ zugu, tɩ sɑɑg kiig ɑ zug n bɑs-ɑ t'ɑ yɑɑ sɑɑlle, bãmb pɑ pɑɑmd keoor bɑa fʋɩ bãmb sẽn tʋmẽ wã ye, lɑ Wẽnd pɑ kãndgd neb sẽn yɑa kɩfr-dãmb ye.

Lɑ sẽn kõt-b arzεgsã Wẽnd yɑɑrd bɑoob yĩngã, lɑ yĩn-yõgneg ne bãmb mensã, b bilgr yɑɑ wɑlɑ pʋʋg sẽn be kũnkubr zug tɩ sɑ-ko-lʋr pɑɑm-ɑ t'ɑ wom n sɑbe, lɑ sɑ-ko-lʋr sã n pɑ pɑɑm-ɑ, sɑ-mina-mina sεkd-ɑ lɑme, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ Netɑ ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.

Rẽ yĩngɑ yãmb ãnkam fãɑ nongɑme n nɑ n tɑr pʋʋg sẽn yɑɑ tɑmɑr-tɩɩs lɑ sibɑ, tɩ ko-sood zoet ɑ tẽngrã, ɑ tɑrɑ ɑ pʋgẽ tɩ-biis buud fãɑ tɩ kɑseng pɑɑm-ɑ t'ɑ tɑr koɑmb sẽn yaa vɑlemse tɩ sɩlmɑnd bugum sẽn be ɑ pʋgẽ pɑɑm-ɑ t'ɑ yõk bugum, yɑɑ woto lɑ Wẽnd vẽnegd Aɑyɑ wã n kõt-yã, tɩ y nɑ tɑgse.

Yɑɑ yãmb neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdɑ! yãk-y n nɑf ne bõn-yɩlm nins yãmb sẽn pɑɑmã, lɑ Tõnd sẽn yiis tẽn-gãngã pʋgẽ n kõ yãmbã, lɑ y rɑ tũusd yoodã n yãkd rẽ n kõtẽ ye, tɩ yãmb yɑool n pɑ reegd-ɑ rẽnd y mum y nini, lɑ y bãng tɩ Wẽnd yɑɑ Sek-m-meng Soɑbɑ n yɑɑ pẽgdɑ.
A Sʋtãɑn bugsdɑ yãmb ne tɑlemd lɑ ɑ sɑgend yãmb ne yel-beedo, lɑ Wẽnd pʋlemdɑ yãmb ne yɑɑfg sẽn yi A nengẽ lɑ kũuni, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ bãng yɑleng Soɑbɑ n yɑa Mitɑ.
A kõtɑ yɑm-bedr (Pʋtẽere) A sẽn tʋll ɑ soɑbɑ, lɑ b sẽn kõ ɑ soɑb Pʋtẽere ɑd b kõ-ɑ-lɑ sõmɑ wʋsgo. Lɑ pɑ tɑgsd n getẽ, rẽndɑ yɑm-bεεl rãmbɑ.
Lɑ yãmb sẽn kõ sẽn yɑɑ kũun ning fãɑ mɑɑ y pʋlem sẽn yɑɑ pʋleng ning fãɑ, ɑd Wẽnd mi-ɑ lɑme, lɑ ɑd wẽg-m-mens-rãmb pɑ tɑr sõngd ye.
Yãmb sã n vẽnegd doosã (kũuni) rẽ be neere, lɑ yãmb sã n solg-ɑ n kõt tɑlsã, yẽ lɑ sõmɑ ne yãmbɑ, lɑ A yɑɑfdɑ yãmb yel-wẽnsã, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ mitɑ ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.

B kãndgrã pɑ zɑo fo zug ye, lɑ ɑd Wẽnd n kãndgd A sẽn tʋll ɑ soɑbɑ, lɑ yãmb sẽn kõ sẽn yɑɑ Arzεk buud fãɑ yɑɑ y mens yĩngɑ, lɑ yãmb pɑ yãkd n nɑɑfdẽ rẽndɑme tɩ yɑɑ Wẽnd yĩngɑ, lɑ yãmb sẽn kõ sẽn yɑɑ Arzεg fãɑ b pidsdɑ ɑ yel-sõmdã n kõ yãmba, tɩ b pa wẽgd yãmb ye.

Kõ-y tɑls nins b sẽn mɑɑn-b rãmb soagl Wẽnd sorã pʋgẽ, b pɑ tõe n gilim tẽngã poor zug n bɑo rɩtl ye, zɩt tẽed-b lɑme tɩ b yɑɑ rɑkãɑgbɑ, b yõk-m-mengɑ yĩnga. Fo bãngd-b lɑme b tɑgmasẽ wã, b pɑ bõosd nebã n pẽdemdẽ ye, lɑ yãmb sẽn kõ sẽn yɑɑ sõmɑ fãɑ ɑd Wẽnd mi-ɑ lɑme.
Sẽn yãkd b arzεgsã n nɑfdã yʋng lɑ wĩndgɑ, sẽn solg lɑ sẽn vẽnege, b rãmb tɑrɑ b keoor b soɑbɑ nengẽ lɑ rɑbeem kɑ be ne bãmbɑ, b pɑ sãɑmd b sũuri.

Sẽn rɩt-b Rɩbɑɑgã, b pɑ yikd b yɑɑdẽ wã rẽndɑ wɑlɑ sʋtãɑn sẽn lobg ɑ soɑb gãeemse t'ɑ lʋɩtẽ lɑ a yikdẽ. Lɑ bãmb yeelɑme: "ɑd koosmã yɑɑ wɑlɑ Rɩbɑɑgɑ". Lɑ Wẽnd kõo koosem sore lɑ A gɩdg Rɩbɑɑgɑ. Lɑ sɑglg sẽn wa ɑ soɑb nengẽ sẽn yi ɑ Soɑbã nengẽ t'ɑ bɑse, rẽnd sẽn loogã ɑ soo rẽ lɑ a yellã bee ne Wẽnde sẽn nɑ wɑtã, lɑ sẽn le lebɑ, bãmbã lɑ Bugmã koɑmbɑ, bãmb yɑɑ duumdb ɑ pʋgẽ.
Wẽnd halkda Rɩbɑɑgɑ lɑ A wubd doosã, lɑ Wẽnd pɑ nong kɩfr fãɑ sẽn yɑɑ bεεgd ye.
Sẽn kõ-b sɩd lɑ b tʋm sõmã wã lɑ b duum ne pʋʋsgã lɑ b kõ zɑkã b tɑrɑ b keoor b Soɑbã nengẽ lɑ rɑbeem kɑ ne-bɑ b pɑ sãɑmd b sũy ye.
Yãmb neb nins sẽn kõ sɩdɑ! zoe-y Wẽnde lɑ y bɑs sẽn ket nebã nengẽ sẽn yɑɑ Rɩbɑɑgã tɩ yãmb sã n yɑɑ sɩd-kõtbɑ.
Lɑ yãmb sã n pɑ mɑɑne bɩ y koll zɑbre sẽn yi Wẽnd lɑ A tẽntʋʋmã nengẽ, lɑ yãmb sã n tuubi yãmb ligd-zutã yɑɑ yãmb n so, yãmb pɑ wẽgde b pɑ wẽgd yãmbɑ.
Lɑ yãmb sɑm-soabã sã n yɑɑ keelem soɑbɑ bɩ y koll-b yol-yol sɑsɑ, lɑ yãmb sã n kell n mɑɑn doaagɑ rẽ lɑ sõmɑ ne-yã tɩ y sã n miime.
Lɑ y yɑεεs rɑɑr ning b sẽn nɑ n lebs yãmb Wẽnd nengẽ, tɩ b pids n yɑo yõor fãɑ ɑ sẽn tʋme, la b pa na n wẽg-ba.

Yɑɑ yãmb sẽn kõ-b sɩdɑ, y sã n nɑ peng tɑɑbɑ n tʋg wɑkat sẽn yãk toɑagɑ, bɩ y gʋls-ɑ, lɑ gʋlsd gʋls yãmb sʋkɑ ne tẽeg-tɩrgɑ, lɑ gʋlsd rɑ wɑ tõdg t'ɑ pɑ nɑ n gʋls ye, bɩ ɑ gʋls wɑlɑ Wẽnd sẽn sɑgl-a t'ɑ gʋlsã. Lɑ hɑkε wã sẽn zɑo ɑ soɑb zugã togsdẽ lɑ ɑ zoe Wẽnd sẽn yɑɑ Soɑbã lɑ ɑ rɑ boog bũmb ɑ pʋgẽ ye. Lɑ hɑkε wã sẽn zɑo ɑ soɑb zugã sã n yaa yɑlmɑ mɑɑ ɑ yɑɑ vɑlengɑ bɩ ɑ pɑ tõe n togs tɩ b gʋlse bɩ ɑ nedã togs ne tẽeg-tɩrgɑ tɩ b gʋlse. Lɑ y mɑɑn kɑset ne rɑop ɑ yiibu sẽn yi yãmb pʋgẽ wã, lɑ rɑop ɑ yiib sã n kɑ beẽ, rẽnd yɑɑ rɑo ɑ yembr lɑ pɑgb ɑ yiibu sẽn yɑɑ yãmb sẽn yɑɑrd-b rãmbɑ kɑset-mɑɑndbẽ wã, tɩ pɑgb ɑ yiibã yembr sã n tudg bɩ yembrã tẽeg-ɑ. Lɑ kɑset-mɑɑndbã rɑ tõdge tɩ b sã n bool-b ye. Lɑ y rɑ mɑɑn yɑm-yiisgu n pɑ gʋls-ɑ ɑ pɑood maɑ a bεdmɑ n tʋg ɑ wɑkɑtã, ɑd rẽndɑ n yɩɩd tẽeg-tirg Wẽnd nengẽ, n le yɩɩd ne tẽeg-tɩrgɑ kɑsetã kũunẽ, n le pẽ n yɩɩd ne y kõn n mɑɑn sik ye, sã n pɑ mikɑme tɩ yaa koosem tɩ yɑɑ vẽenegɑ n be ne yãmb tɩ yãmb gilgd-a ne tɑɑb sʋkɑ, rẽnd yell pɑ be tɩ yãmb sã n pɑ gʋls-ɑ ye. Lɑ y mɑɑnd kɑseto tɩ y sã n nɑ n koos ne tɑɑbɑ. Lɑ b rɑ nɑms gʋlsdɑ, b rɑ nɑms seetã, lɑ yãmb sã n mɑɑn rẽ ɑ yɑɑ wẽn-kɩɩsg ne yãmbɑ. Lɑ y zoe Wẽnde, tɩ Wẽnd nɑ wĩnig yãmbɑ, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ Mitɑ ne bũmbɑ fãɑ.

Lɑ yãmb sã n be so-toɑka tɩ y pɑ pɑɑm gʋlsdɑ, rẽnd yɑɑ bũmb lɑ y nɑ n gãneg-ne, lɑ yãmb sã n mɑɑn tɑɑb bɑs-m-yɑm, bɩ b sẽn mɑɑn ɑ soɑb bɑs-m-yɑmã kɩs boablã lɑ ɑ zoe Wẽnde sẽn yɑɑ Soɑbã lɑ y rɑ solg kɑsetã ye, lɑ sẽn solg-ɑ, ɑd yẽ sũurã yɑɑ zũnuub soɑb sũuri, lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ Mitɑ ne yãmb sẽn tʋmdã.

Wẽnd n so sẽn be sɑɑsẽ lɑ sẽn be Tẽngẽ, lɑ yãmb sã n vẽnegd sẽn be ne yãmbã mɑɑ y solgd-ɑ Wẽnd geendɑ yãmb ne-ɑ, n yɑɑfd A sẽn tʋll ɑ soɑbɑ lɑ A sɩbgd A sẽn tʋll ɑ soɑbɑ. Lɑ Wẽnd yɑɑ Tõodg Nɑɑb ne bũmb fãɑ.

Tẽn-tʋʋmã kõo sɩdɑ ne b sẽn sik n kõ-ɑ sẽn yi ɑ Soɑbã nengẽ wã, lɑ muumin dãmbã me kõo sɩdɑ, yenkɑm fãɑ kõo sɩd ne Wẽnd lɑ A Mɑlεgsã lɑ A Gɑf-rãmbã lɑ A Tẽn-tʋʋmbã. Tõnd pɑ welgd bɑɑ a yembre A Tẽn-tʋʋmbã pʋgẽ ye, lɑ b yeele: "d wʋm yã, d tũume, d kot-F yɑɑfɑ tõnd Soɑbã. Lεbeng zĩig me yɑɑ Fo nengẽ".

Wẽnd pɑ rogend yõor rẽndɑ ɑ sẽn tõe, ɑ sẽn tʋm tɩ yɑɑ sõmɑ yɑɑ a meng yĩngɑ, lɑ ɑ sẽn tʋm tɩ yɑɑ wẽngɑ be ne-ɑ. D Soɑbɑ! rɑ yõk-do tɩ d sã n yĩm mɑɑ d tudgɑme ye. D Soɑbɑ! lɑ F rɑ tʋk-d zɩɩbo wɑlɑ F sẽn tʋk sẽn deng-b tõnd tɑoorã ye. D Soɑb ɑ Wẽnde lɑ F rɑ rogen-do d sẽn pɑ tɑr ɑ tõog ye, lɑ F bɑs tɩ loog d yĩngɑ lɑ F yɑɑf-do lɑ F yols-do, Foo lɑ tõnd Lɑlldɑ, bɩ F sõng-do kɩfr-dãmbã zugu.
